programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Pickles reunites with his old hair band, "Snakes 'N' Barrels", which has the rest of Dethklok worried that their drummer may leave them. When the ten-years-sober "Snakes 'N' Barrels" are given experimental psychotropic drugs before their performance, the result is something beyond brutal.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Dethklok has opened up their home for their annual Dethfan Day. Dethklok continues with their "normal" everyday activities (like liver transplant surgery and scrubbing toilets) while fans are ushered around the house, guided by an animated skull and a maze of velvet rope. Dethklok finds themselves in a sticky situation when two Internet geeks threaten to bring down Dethklok with their advanced Photoshopping skills.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: In a last-ditch scramble for tax breaks, Dethklok agrees to host an event with the London Philharmonic, but only under one condition: Dethklok gets to produce their own kind of laser light show. They've also taken in a distempered fat kid they found, and must juggle the responsibilities of parenting while upholding their charitable agreement.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Skwisgaar is to host the Skwisgaar Skwigelf Advanced Hand Finger Wizard Master Class Pay Per View Event, to promote the sales of a new guitar line, which includes the Skwisarmyatar, and the Antfarmatar.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Dethklok has an end of the quarter employee evaluation to find out who's been embezzling from the company. The patronizing evaluation heads off with a pep talk and a corporate video that will have audiences and Dethfans alike vying for a spot on the Dethklok payroll.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Plagued by his stupidity, Nathan Explosion embarks on the dicey journey of earning his GED.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Depressed, Dethklok is whisked away to the Mississippi Delta to "discover" the Blues.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Murderface searches for a religion after a near-death experience leaves him longing for greater meaning. He samples everything from Christianity to Satanism before finding his true church.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Toki tries to compensate for his adorable charm by over-brutalizing his intentions and actions.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: The Tribunal commissions Dr. Rockzo, The Rock N Roll Clown, to gather information on Dethklok. Dr. Rockzo and Toki's sudden friendship has the rest of Dethklok uneasy.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Dethklok is asked to host the American Pornography Awards, but Nathan's controlling girlfriend puts a damper on the situation for the whole band.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: When Dethklok is given a Carte Blanche development deal, the future of silver screen entertainment rests in their hands.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: In this first season finale, the Metalocalypse creeps closer to fulfillment when Dethklok executes their most brutal performance to date, and the Tribunal finally makes their move.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Since Dethklok's withdrawal from the public following the purported Dethwater Live "fan attack", the world economy teeters on the brink of disaster. Dethklok is finally lured back into the outside world with their protective "pelvic-thrust mace belts" to be a part of the world's largest public execution of criminals in recorded history.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Toki Wartooth is fed up playing in the shadow of Skwisgaar's lead guitar. Under the tutelage of a crusty old guitar master, Toki learns that the heart, too, has strings.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: The wounded, the scared, and the disfigured unite. Meanwhile, an oblivious Dethklok spends their studio time recording onto the purest of all analog formats: water.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Fearing for their safety after a public gun mishap/bloodbath, the CFO hires look-a-likes of Dethklok to make public appearances while the band prepares for a Duncan Hills Coffee promotional event.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: When promoting a new clothing line, Dethklok experiences the brutality of negative body image, dieting, and bulimia.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Dr. Rockzo, the Rock n Roll Clown, gets help from Dethklok to overcome his cocaine addition and come c-c-c-clean!

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Metal meets mid-west etiquette when Pickles' brother, Seth, invites Dethklok to his Wisconsin wedding.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Pickles' popularity soars when he gets a personal P.R. agent, prompting the rest of Dethklok to form a rival P.R. firm. Meanwhile, Pickles' P.R. woman has dark, otherworldy, and religious motives behind her Evil Press Releases.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Dethklok travels to the Amazon where they learn about native brutality from the Yannemango Indians.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Nathan Explosion serves an emergency term as temporary governor for the state of Florida, sending Florida into a state of further emergency.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: William Murderface creates the "Nascar-type Theatrical Hybrid Event" and takes all creative and logistical control upon himself. Nathan and Pickles try to be supportive of their overwhelmed pal, while Skwisgaar and Toki attempt to get their driver licenses.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: When Nathan learns that his ex-girlfriend, Rebecca Nightrod, has already found new love while still in a coma, he decides to return to the dating scene. Unfortunately, the rest of the band makes it difficult for Nathan to make a true love connection.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: The band is fed up with Offdenson knowing more than they do. They want their fifth of everything and decide to hire an efficiency expert to tighten up matters at Mordhaus and maximize their weekly allowance.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: When Toki gets news that his dad is dying, he's forced to travel back to his home town in Norway. The rest of the band decides to make a vacation out of it, citing "album inspiration" as their excuse to further put off working on their delayed album.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: The world economy is crumbling and waiting for the next Dethklok album to stimulate it back into order. It's up to Dethklok to get the album just right and finished on time.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: After the attack on Mordhaus, Dethklok is left without a manager and plagued by greedy record execs and forced to face the brutality of the slumping economy while dabbling in interior design. Will they spend everything and sign a deal that will render them powerless? Or worse, will they allow Murderface to turn the living room into an Arizona-styled sandscape?

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Dethklok joins their own Dethklok tribute band as a last ditch effort to connect with their rock and roll roots.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: After a near-death experience, Dethklok realizes they would rather be sick and not know then face the brutality of going to a doctor. After home remedies including drinking bleach, Dethklok learns that their ultimate fear will be realized, one of them has a terminal illness. Meanwhile Nathan tries to brave the brutality of going to the dentist and Murderface faces the possibility of being gay after accidentally ejaculating on a doctors face. Part of Season 3.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Dethklok must experience the ultimate brutality of the Holiday season; spending time with their MOTHERS. Meanwhile Murderface ringleads the ultimate Christmas special that ends up being backed by the Christian church. And a particular ROCK AND ROLL clown makes a holiday appearance. Part of season 3.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: After an onslaught of paternity suits, Skwisgaar realizes he will never change until he quits the band to find his father who abandoned him before birth.Meanwhile, Dethklok realizes they all have father abandonment issues and Murderface decides to repair the damages by appointing himself "Band Father."

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Toki falls head over heals for a girl he meets online. When things sour he tries to break it off and instead has to bear the brutality of being her date at her father's vegan funeral in 110 degree heat. Meanwhile Nathan experiences the brutality of dating a performance artist. And Murderface must attend a sexual harassment seminar after trying to match Skwisgaar's sexual prowess.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Murderface wants the easy life but still wants all the rewards. After the band decides to kick him out for making their jobs more difficult, Murderface realizes the EASIEST way to make BIG money is to start his own label.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: After Drunk driving HOVER DRUMS and causing billions in damage Pickles the drummer is thrown into rehab and his worst nightmares are realized when he is replaced- by a drum machine.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Toki tries to turn the life of his rock-and-roll clown friend, Dr. Rockzo, around by investing Dethklok's vacation fund. Everything goes smoothly until the media peers into Rockzo's past and discovers the clown's darkest secret.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: While Dethklok's manager, Charles Offdensen, is absent cleaning up hundreds of problems caused by the band, Dethklok double books a gig--between Syria and Israel on the same day.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Despite his bandmates' warnings, Nathan begins seriously dating one of his fans. But as the evidence of her past piles up, to prove her innocence, he follows her to the most brutal place on earth: Klokikon - the annual Dethklok fan convention filled with cosplay geeks and homosexual fan art. Meanwhile, the rest of the band starts smoking after Murderface lands the cover of Smokaroonie Aficionado.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: After Dethklok is accused of being racist at a huge press conference, they combat the charges by opening an Urban Youth Dethcenter. Meanwhile, Toki, after being left behind, starts a special club that promotes equality and love but excludes Murderface because he doesn't have the right look.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: With their new album finally shipping, Dethklok plans their post-release traditions of vacationing, goofing off, palling around, and prank calls. Nathan, however, can't shake the feeling that something is wrong with the record... After being humiliated by Murderface's prank calls, Skwisgaar and Toki swear revenge.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Dethklok heads to Tomahawk, Wisconsin to open a Dethfair in hopes that it will stimulate the economy they destroyed. Pickles uses this time at home to reconnect with his disapproving mother who tells him that she won't respect him until he gets a real job. Pickles decides to hang up his drumsticks and goes into an even more brutal profession: he becomes a realtor.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Tired of taking verbal abuse from his bandmate, Toki writes a tell-all book called Skwisgaar Is Ams Dick and takes over as Dethklok's lead guitarist. But can Toki handle the spotlight? Meanwhile, Nathan buys a new favorite toy for the band: a defibrillator.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: After spending all their time with sluts and squandering the budget on their new record, Dethklok is shocked to find they've been assigned a new producer: A WOMAN. She sends them on a pre-writing vacation that turns out to be a brutal trip to a third world country where they're mistaken as women and captured as sex slaves.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: In an effort to make friends, Toki goes to Rockaroonie Fantasy Camp - a weekend getaway to rub elbows with rock and roll royalty (but he attends as a camper.) Instead of meeting friends, he is bullied by other campers and has no one to turn to but celebrity counselor, Magnus Hammersmith; ex-Dethklok guitarist with a troubled past. With Toki - the diabetic scaredy cat - out of Mordhaus, Skwisgaar and Murderface act out and over do it with candy and scary movies.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: After Murderface is announced as the recipient of this year's Most Brutal Looking Musician Award, he travels to Mexico to get the best and cheapest plastic surgery possible. Meanwhile, the rest of Dethklok deal with the brutality of aging and letting themselves go.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Dethklok returns to the water to record in their new Dethsub but, plagued with the lack of women, carpel tunnel sets in from excessive masturbation. The band regresses to an animal mindset. Pickles and Nathan spend their energy crossing the workplace relationship line and competing for the only woman on the sub: their producer.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: As Dethklok hosts the most important dinner of their career, the divvying of album credits, over tagging on social networking sites, and fights over a girl come to head. Can CFO keep their issues in check? Will the record executives forgive them for the past year of mistakes? Or will it be a total, brutal disaster?

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: While the world awaits the final Dethklok performance, members of the band prepare for their post-Dethklok careers. Pickles starts a winery for the most alcoholic wine ever, Nathan and Swkisgaar look for a brand new sound that doesn't suck, and Toki works with Murderface on his campaign for congressman. Meanwhile, Salacia takes Dethklok's weakness as the opportune time to strike!

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Dethklok is notified of a looming secret that's been around for hundreds of years: the secret of the Metalocalypse. Before they can contemplate what this means, however, Nathan must give a eulogy and do the most brutal thing he has ever done: get in touch with his emotions.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.sub-title: METALOCALYPSE: the DOOMSTAR REQUIEM A KLOK OPERA
programme.desc: Will Dethklok find their lost bandmate Toki Wartooth? Find out in this hour long Rock Opera special featuring a 50 piece orchestra and special guests Mark Hamill, Malcolm McDowell, and Cannibal Corpse's George "Corpsegrinder" Fisher.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: After performing a coffee jingle in the farthest reaches of the Arctic Circle to a sold-out crowd, Dethklok witnesses their French chef being chopped to pieces by the blade of their helicopter restaurant. The bad news is that Dethklok is now faced with the daunting task of cooking dinner themselves.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: In an attempt to make their next album the most brutal ever, Dethklok commissions a Russian nuclear submarine to record deep in the Nordic waters. Underwater, the band copes with seasickness, whale and radar pings infecting their tracks, and loss of food and oxygen.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: The band plays a song that unintentionally wakes a deadly Nordic Forest Troll. Dethklok doesn't care until they learn that the Troll is knocking out all DSL lines, making their Internet really slow. Dethklok must write the world's first Death Metal Lullaby to put the demonic beast back to sleep.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: In a legendary bad move, Dethklok decides to do standup comedy. Pickles remains traumatized by a heckler while the rest of Dethklok learns that comedy is all about embracing the hate. Dethklok finds that they are very much naturals at this. The physical comedy routine they work out really kills.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Uncomfortable and embarrassed, Dethklok painfully endures while their parents are in town for a visit. The guys are at first pissed and doubtful when their parents announce the release of their "Parents of Dethklok" album, but are then impressed by the depth of their parents' anger.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Pickles reunites with his old hair band, "Snakes 'N' Barrels", which has the rest of Dethklok worried that their drummer may leave them. When the ten-years-sober "Snakes 'N' Barrels" are given experimental psychotropic drugs before their performance, the result is something beyond brutal.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Dethklok has opened up their home for their annual Dethfan Day. Dethklok continues with their "normal" everyday activities (like liver transplant surgery and scrubbing toilets) while fans are ushered around the house, guided by an animated skull and a maze of velvet rope. Dethklok finds themselves in a sticky situation when two Internet geeks threaten to bring down Dethklok with their advanced Photoshopping skills.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: In a last-ditch scramble for tax breaks, Dethklok agrees to host an event with the London Philharmonic, but only under one condition: Dethklok gets to produce their own kind of laser light show. They've also taken in a distempered fat kid they found, and must juggle the responsibilities of parenting while upholding their charitable agreement.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Skwisgaar is to host the Skwisgaar Skwigelf Advanced Hand Finger Wizard Master Class Pay Per View Event, to promote the sales of a new guitar line, which includes the Skwisarmyatar, and the Antfarmatar.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Dethklok has an end of the quarter employee evaluation to find out who's been embezzling from the company. The patronizing evaluation heads off with a pep talk and a corporate video that will have audiences and Dethfans alike vying for a spot on the Dethklok payroll.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Plagued by his stupidity, Nathan Explosion embarks on the dicey journey of earning his GED.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Depressed, Dethklok is whisked away to the Mississippi Delta to "discover" the Blues.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Murderface searches for a religion after a near-death experience leaves him longing for greater meaning. He samples everything from Christianity to Satanism before finding his true church.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Toki tries to compensate for his adorable charm by over-brutalizing his intentions and actions.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: The Tribunal commissions Dr. Rockzo, The Rock N Roll Clown, to gather information on Dethklok. Dr. Rockzo and Toki's sudden friendship has the rest of Dethklok uneasy.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Dethklok is asked to host the American Pornography Awards, but Nathan's controlling girlfriend puts a damper on the situation for the whole band.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: When Dethklok is given a Carte Blanche development deal, the future of silver screen entertainment rests in their hands.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: In this first season finale, the Metalocalypse creeps closer to fulfillment when Dethklok executes their most brutal performance to date, and the Tribunal finally makes their move.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Since Dethklok's withdrawal from the public following the purported Dethwater Live "fan attack", the world economy teeters on the brink of disaster. Dethklok is finally lured back into the outside world with their protective "pelvic-thrust mace belts" to be a part of the world's largest public execution of criminals in recorded history.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Toki Wartooth is fed up playing in the shadow of Skwisgaar's lead guitar. Under the tutelage of a crusty old guitar master, Toki learns that the heart, too, has strings.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: The wounded, the scared, and the disfigured unite. Meanwhile, an oblivious Dethklok spends their studio time recording onto the purest of all analog formats: water.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Fearing for their safety after a public gun mishap/bloodbath, the CFO hires look-a-likes of Dethklok to make public appearances while the band prepares for a Duncan Hills Coffee promotional event.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: When promoting a new clothing line, Dethklok experiences the brutality of negative body image, dieting, and bulimia.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Dr. Rockzo, the Rock n Roll Clown, gets help from Dethklok to overcome his cocaine addition and come c-c-c-clean!

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Metal meets mid-west etiquette when Pickles' brother, Seth, invites Dethklok to his Wisconsin wedding.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Pickles' popularity soars when he gets a personal P.R. agent, prompting the rest of Dethklok to form a rival P.R. firm. Meanwhile, Pickles' P.R. woman has dark, otherworldy, and religious motives behind her Evil Press Releases.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Dethklok travels to the Amazon where they learn about native brutality from the Yannemango Indians.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Nathan Explosion serves an emergency term as temporary governor for the state of Florida, sending Florida into a state of further emergency.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: William Murderface creates the "Nascar-type Theatrical Hybrid Event" and takes all creative and logistical control upon himself. Nathan and Pickles try to be supportive of their overwhelmed pal, while Skwisgaar and Toki attempt to get their driver licenses.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: When Nathan learns that his ex-girlfriend, Rebecca Nightrod, has already found new love while still in a coma, he decides to return to the dating scene. Unfortunately, the rest of the band makes it difficult for Nathan to make a true love connection.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: The band is fed up with Offdenson knowing more than they do. They want their fifth of everything and decide to hire an efficiency expert to tighten up matters at Mordhaus and maximize their weekly allowance.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: When Toki gets news that his dad is dying, he's forced to travel back to his home town in Norway. The rest of the band decides to make a vacation out of it, citing "album inspiration" as their excuse to further put off working on their delayed album.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: The world economy is crumbling and waiting for the next Dethklok album to stimulate it back into order. It's up to Dethklok to get the album just right and finished on time.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: After the attack on Mordhaus, Dethklok is left without a manager and plagued by greedy record execs and forced to face the brutality of the slumping economy while dabbling in interior design. Will they spend everything and sign a deal that will render them powerless? Or worse, will they allow Murderface to turn the living room into an Arizona-styled sandscape?

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Dethklok joins their own Dethklok tribute band as a last ditch effort to connect with their rock and roll roots.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: After a near-death experience, Dethklok realizes they would rather be sick and not know then face the brutality of going to a doctor. After home remedies including drinking bleach, Dethklok learns that their ultimate fear will be realized, one of them has a terminal illness. Meanwhile Nathan tries to brave the brutality of going to the dentist and Murderface faces the possibility of being gay after accidentally ejaculating on a doctors face. Part of Season 3.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Dethklok must experience the ultimate brutality of the Holiday season; spending time with their MOTHERS. Meanwhile Murderface ringleads the ultimate Christmas special that ends up being backed by the Christian church. And a particular ROCK AND ROLL clown makes a holiday appearance. Part of season 3.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: After an onslaught of paternity suits, Skwisgaar realizes he will never change until he quits the band to find his father who abandoned him before birth.Meanwhile, Dethklok realizes they all have father abandonment issues and Murderface decides to repair the damages by appointing himself "Band Father."

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Toki falls head over heals for a girl he meets online. When things sour he tries to break it off and instead has to bear the brutality of being her date at her father's vegan funeral in 110 degree heat. Meanwhile Nathan experiences the brutality of dating a performance artist. And Murderface must attend a sexual harassment seminar after trying to match Skwisgaar's sexual prowess.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Murderface wants the easy life but still wants all the rewards. After the band decides to kick him out for making their jobs more difficult, Murderface realizes the EASIEST way to make BIG money is to start his own label.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: After Drunk driving HOVER DRUMS and causing billions in damage Pickles the drummer is thrown into rehab and his worst nightmares are realized when he is replaced- by a drum machine.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Toki tries to turn the life of his rock-and-roll clown friend, Dr. Rockzo, around by investing Dethklok's vacation fund. Everything goes smoothly until the media peers into Rockzo's past and discovers the clown's darkest secret.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: While Dethklok's manager, Charles Offdensen, is absent cleaning up hundreds of problems caused by the band, Dethklok double books a gig--between Syria and Israel on the same day.

programme.desc: The RC crew sees Daredevil wasn't the only one to lose his senses in an accident. Hogwarts doesn't teach birth control. Solid Snake gives away his position in the bathroom. The Micronauts get the greatest or worst public transportation system.

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.desc: RC explains why Superman wishes he'd locked the door of the Fortress of Solitude. The Robot Chicken Nerd dies or has sex or neither? You are probably smarter than a fifth grader. The Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles get surplus military hardware.

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.desc: From the minds of the writers, we watch as Liam Neeson finds his seat in the movies has been…taken. A veterinarian explains how 101 dalmatians reproduce. Monster High steals the Crypt Keeper's schtick.

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.desc: The RC writers uncover the outtakes from Seth Green's classic Burger King commerical. Krang lies on his online dating profile. Andy's latest toy doesn't fit in with the Toy Story gang. Huey Lewis' lost "Back to the Future" hit song.

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.desc: The mic has been dropped by those hardcore Robot Chicken writers…but Walter White Jr. picks it up. The Exo-Squad's suits are ready for job #1, but not job #2. Remy makes a new kind of ratatouille.

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.desc: The writers of Robot Chicken imagine what would happen if Darth Vader learned to say "I'm Sorry." Bugs Bunny takes his cross-dressing to the next level. The Terminator changes the future a bit too much. Edna Mode gets an incredible new job.

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.sub-title: Angelic Sounds of Mike Giggling, The
programme.desc: Lois Lane is dead, but was it…super murder? Batman asks if Superman can bleed, but maybe he could care less. You vote on the season 8 finale spectacular!

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.sub-title: Freshly Baked: The Robot Chicken Santa Claus Pot Cookie Freakout Special: Special Edition
programme.desc: Happy holidays everyone, as Robot Chicken joins Santa for the one Christmas he'll never forget. The north pole elves dream of the toys of holidays past. Krampus puts in a good word for the coal industry. St. Nick meets his idol: Jared Leto.

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.desc: The Robot Chicken writers are back at work on a new season, but had to take Fury Road to get to the office! Also, Beavis has moved on from his life with Butthead, and Robot Chicken's Nerd is the latest guest in Westworld.

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.sub-title: Things Look Bad for the Streepster
programme.desc: Daniel Tiger is taught the toughest lesson of all, thanks to Robot Chicken! A Nerd looks behind the curtain at Nick's Arcade and hates it. Jabberjaw goes on a much-needed vacation... to Amity Island.

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.desc: The Robot Chicken team discovers the emotions of adulthood in Inside Out 2. The pig from Black Mirror tells all to Howard Stern. The Nerd forces his way through Star Wars: Force Awakens.

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.desc: Robot Chicken joins the dinosaur revolution as Fred Flintstone runs for his life! Sebastian has union trouble with his orchestra. The MCU holds an intervention for Jessica Jones.

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.desc: RC wonders how Harriet the Spy would fit into the modern world of Cyberwarfare. The Midnight Society figures out what is truly scary. Alvin and the Chipmunks play Coachella for the first and last time.

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.sub-title: We Don't See Much of That in 1940's America

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.desc: Robot Chicken's writers can't get a grasp of Fight Club's rules. Was old Rose's Titanic flashback just a tall tale? Zack Morris takes a time out with the Avengers.

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.desc: Robot Chicken wants to show you the monster in its pocket. Megatron goes too far in Beast Wars. Wile E Coyote sees if he can Get Away With Murder!

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.desc: The minds at Robot Chicken uncover the real reason Indiana Jones hates snakes. Maxwell Lord gets an inside look at Supergirl's weakness. Date My Mom focuses on Jessica Rabbit's huge... personality.

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.desc: The proud citizens of Robot Chicken stand up and demand the Furby genocide be recognized! Who watches the Watchmens' mouths? Bitch Pudding doesn't want to hear The Sound of Music.

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.sub-title: What Can You Tell Me About Butt Rashes?
programme.desc: The staff at Robot Chicken finally envision what a Sailor Earth would look like as the Sailor Scouts head out for churros. The Wicked Witch has some last-minute confessions you may not enjoy hearing. Richie Rich gets a lesson in capitalism.

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.desc: The Robot Chicken crew witness the straw that breaks Captain Planet's back. A Spider-Man secret is revealed thanks to J. Jonah Jameson. The Nerd realizes his problems are Legion.

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.desc: The creators of Robot Chicken revisit the POG craze for some reason. Mulan's disguise has worked too well. Rita Repulsa advertises a new use for her wand, and the Power Rangers refuse to pay the price!

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.desc: Robot Chicken is there when one of Scooby Doo's villains realizes the silliness of his plan. Super Grover's secret identity is revealed! Calvin grows up but Hobbes wants no part of it.

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.sub-title: He's Not Even Aiming at the Toilet
programme.desc: Robot Chicken reviews all the Star Wars plot holes that Galen Erso helped close in Rogue One. Peppa Pig's family deal with Brexit fallout. Some swine dare to make a knock-off of the Broadway mega-hit Hamilton.

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.sub-title: Your Mouth Is Hanging off Your Face
programme.desc: Are the Robot Chicken writers the only ones to notice that King Kong fell from the Empire State Building butt-first? The Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles don't have money to pay for that pizza. The Smurfs try to Smurf themselves some Sudafed.

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.sub-title: No Wait, He Has a Cane
programme.desc: The writers of Robot Chicken tell Two-Face the most they've ever lost on a coin toss. The Joker bombs on stage, but not in our hearts. Jon Snow faces the greatest threat Westeros has ever seen!

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.desc: Robot Chicken ends the season with a bang and some nudity as the Nerd jumps the Grand Canyon. Stranger Things are happening to the school bully… VERY Stranger Things. Witness the greatest Japanese commercial of ALL TIME!

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.desc: Robot Chicken Writers tell us what can take down the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles. Popeye and crew get rebooted to fit in with today's audience. And Bitch Pudding takes on the role of a Handmaid.

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.sub-title: Fila Ogden in: Maggie's Got a Full Load
programme.desc: April O'Neil and Donald Trump sit down and get to the truth about Shredder. We get a first glimpse at the The Fast and The Furious movies. The RC Writers show us what happened to Pee Wee's Playhouse while for his stolen bicycle.

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.desc: The Queer Eye guys take on their greatest challenge! Princess Leia gets blasted into space and emerges as Super Space Leia. Robot Chicken puts together a musical number starring Offred and Commander Waterford from A Handmaid's Tale.

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.sub-title: Garfield Stockman in: A Voice Like Wet Ham
programme.desc: Freddy Krueger is getting married and just wants an answer to one simple question: Who is his father? The RC team shows what it's like being the daughter of a plastic Army Man. The Totally Spies girls learn international law...and get PTSD.

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.sub-title: Boogie Bardstown in: No Need, I have Coupons
programme.desc: The RC creators imagine what would have happened if Stretch Armstrong had lived during Medieval times. The G.I. Joe team realizes that solving real world problems aren't so easy. Gordon Ramsey gets some pretty impressive celebrity chef's.

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.sub-title: Snoopy Camino Lindo in: Quick and Dirty Squirrel Shot
programme.desc: The Scooby Gang saves Velma's from getting cancer. We see what really happened on board Noah's ark. The Robot Chicken Writers wonder what happens to all the toys that have ever been recalled.

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.sub-title: Molly Lucero in: Your Friend's Boob
programme.desc: Betty Spaghetty tries her best to save an elevator full of people. RC finds out what goes on behind Bert and Ernie's closed bedroom doors. Godzilla: The Musical comes to a Broadway theatre and brings the house down.

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.sub-title: Spike Fraser in: Should I Happen to Back into a Horse
programme.desc: The Robot Chicken crew reveals what really happened to Bambi's mother. An Animorph revives the Red Panda population. See what happens after Brainy Smurf gets diagnosed with CTE. And Bitch Pudding goes up against Norman Bates.

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.desc: The Squatch Squad emerges from hiding to protect their forest home. The Wuzzles meet The Fly and things get a little bit crazy. The RC writers show us Bill & Ted's last and greatest adventure.

programme.sub-title: Max Caenen in: Why Would He Know If His Mother's A Size Queen
programme.desc: The Lady of the Lake gives Percival some trouble. The Robot Chicken crew shows what Dumbledore sees in the Mirror of Desire. Professor X reveals how the X-Men first discovered their powers. And Garfield gets buried in the pet cemetery.

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.sub-title: Petless M in: Cars are Couches of the Road
programme.desc: The RC writers imagine Harry Potter as a 70's sitcom. The future looks bleak for Nostradamus's assistant. We answer the question of what's underneath Abe Lincoln's hat. And the Jonas Brothers learn they are more than just brothers.

programme.sub-title: Buster Olive in: The Monkey Got Closer Overnight
programme.desc: Tyrion Lannister learns the true meaning of "winter is coming." Blade tries to slice his way into infomercials. Inside Out Boy goes to college. The Robot Chicken writers show what happens when Halloween meets Home Alone.

programme.sub-title: Ghandi Mulholland in: Plastic Doesn't Get Cancer
programme.desc: Good Will Hunting goes Goodwill Hunting. Pennywise the clown shows off some new moves. A Fortnite contractor is hired to build a house. And the RC crew reimagines the show Pete & Pete.

programme.sub-title: Gracie Purgatory in: That's How You Get Hemorrhoids
programme.desc: We learn what Squidward is up to after his role on Spongebob ends. Uber has a new ride share system. Broadway will never be the same after Venom joins the cast of Hamilton. Pink Panther challenges The Black Panther for the throne.

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.sub-title: Sundancer Craig in: 30% of the Way to Crying
programme.desc: Rita Repulsa finally figures out a way to take down The Power Rangers. We get to see Freddy Krueger's worst nightmare. The Robot Chicken crew reveals the monster from Bird Box. We get to see a different viewpoint from the movie Predator.

programme.sub-title: Babe Hollytree in: I Wish One Person Had Died

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.desc: The Super, Extra-Special, One of a Kind, 200th episode spectacular! The Robot Chicken crew finally reveals everything you wanted to know about his experiment with the chicken, the chair, and the televisions.

programme.sub-title: Robot Chicken: Star Wars Episode III
programme.desc: The Emmy Award-winning Robot Chicken returns with its third send-up of the Star Wars universe! programme.title: Ocean Exploration
programme.desc: Host Philippe Cousteau visits the famous Woods Hole Oceanographic Institute and finds what discoveries they've recently made under the deep sea. Then we travel to the Florida coast where Philippe goes scuba diving to observe the health of their coral reefs. Then we go to Maui, Hawaii and explore the power of their massive waves with the help of a professional surfer.

programme.title: Awesome Iceland
programme.desc: Host Philippe Cousteau explores the famous waterfalls and geysers of Iceland. Then he travels up a volcanic mountain, which is expected to erupt at any moment. Philippe also discovers how Iceland uses geothermal and hydro power to produce all their electricity. Finally, Philippe hikes on one of the largest glaciers in the country.

Along the way, Luma began to gravitate toward a more Calvinist expression of Christianity. But when that theology began to unravel, she started to look deeper into historical theology, finding that her true Christian home was in the Catholic Church, which she entered in 2018.

When her family left Iraq before coming to the US, they encountered Evangelical missionaries who told them they were not "real” Christians yet, and that they had to adopt Evangelicalism. Along the way, Luma began to gravitate toward a more Calvinist expression of Christianity. But when that theology began to unravel, she started to look deeper into historical theology, finding that her true Christian home was in the Catholic Church, which she entered in 2018.

programme.title: Sri Lanka : Jésus, Sauve Le Sri Lanka !
programme.desc: Le 21 avril 2019 – le dimanche de Pâques – vers 08h45, une série d'attentats à la bombe a frappé Colombo, la capitale du Sri Lanka, en commençant avec une explosion à l'église catholique de Saint-Antoine, qui a le statut de sanctuaire national. Moins de 45 minutes plus tard, une autre bombe a explosé à l'église catholique Saint-Sébastien de Negomba, tandis qu’une troisième explosion s’est produite à l'église protestante de Sion à Batticaloa. Au même moment, des explosions se sont produites dans trois hôtels de Colombo prisés par les touristes occidentaux. Le bilan définitif est de 264 morts et plus de 500 blessés. L'État islamique a revendiqué les attentats, mais le gouvernement a accusé un groupe extrémiste islamiste local, le National Thawheed Jamaath (NTJ), d'être responsable des attentats. Après près d'un an, 300 personnes ont été arrêtées et certaines des églises ont été réparées, reconsacrées et rouvertes. Aujourd'hui, plus d'un an plus tard, les Srilankais ont toujours peur tout en continuant à soigner leurs blessures physiques et psychologiques.

programme.desc: Esta semana en Vaticano, exploramos el camino cristiano hacia la eternidad. Desde las antiguas catacumbas de Roma, donde los primeros cristianos sepultaban a sus difuntos y proclamaban su esperanza en la vida después de la muerte, hasta el Dicasterio de las Causas de los Santos, donde la Iglesia sigue presentando a hombres y mujeres de virtudes heroicas como modelos de santidad, descubrimos qué significa vivir con el cielo como destino último. También conversamos con un capellán de hospital sobre el sacramento de la Unción de los Enfermos y visitamos el Museo de las Almas del Purgatorio para profundizar en la enseñanza de la Iglesia sobre el purgatorio y en la esperanza que une a vivos y difuntos.

programme.title: La misericordia y el perdón
programme.desc: Cristo es la Cabeza de la Iglesia y todos sus miembros forman parte de ese Cuerpo Místico. Una bella reflexión de cómo ser Iglesia.

programme.title: Camino de esperanza
programme.sub-title: Tres perspectivas sobre el proceso de la nulidad matrimonial
programme.desc: El Proceso de Nulidad Matrimonial ha de verse desde diversas perspectivas: aquí desde la pastoral, eclesial y de la persona.

programme.title: Juan Pablo II en Espana y en el mundo
programme.desc: Un documental que muestra el recorrido del Santo Padre Juan Pablo II por distintos lugares de España, durante las décadas de 1980, 1990 y años recientes.

programme.title: Clásicos Católicos: Madre Angélica presenta
programme.desc: La Madre Angélica ofrece instrucciones detalladas sobre cómo mantenerse firme y hacer lo que el Señor pide, sin importar el costo. Ella está preparando a las personas para un tiempo de gran tribulación que percibe como muy cercano.

programme.title: Clásicos católicos: viviendo las Escrituras
programme.desc: Madre Angélica examina el pasaje de Lucas 7:36-50, donde la mujer pecadora con el frasco de perfume demostró un verdadero arrepentimiento, a diferencia del fariseo.

programme.title: Vaticano

programme.title: Cocina franciscana
programme.desc: Hoy toca receta dulce. Los "donuts" son un bollo muy esponjoso en forma de rosquilla, también se les llaman donas.

programme.title: Canta y no llores
programme.desc: Serie de programas de una hora de duración, grabados en España, con la participación de cantautores y grupos de lo más destacado del panorama de la música religiosa. Presentado por el cantautor hispano - Uruguayo: Luis Alfredo Díaz. Canta y no llores, es un encuentro en profundidad con la música y la espiritualidad.

programme.title: Tertulias de fe
programme.desc: El Padre Gerardo Mendoza es un sacerdote de la Diócesis de San Bernardino que fue ordenado en julio de 1988 y cuenta con casi cuatro décadas de trayectoria pastoral en el sur de California. A lo largo de su ministerio, ha servido como párroco en iglesias de ciudades como Norco e Indio, donde la comunidad hispana lo reconoce por su calidez y su guía espiritual. Además de su labor en las parroquias, ayudó a fundar en 2011 el capítulo en español del movimiento católico Magnificat con la aprobación del obispo de la región.

programme.title: Siervo de todos
programme.desc: En un tiempo en el que la voz del Señor parece ahogada por «otras voces» y la propuesta de seguirlo entregando la propia vida puede parecer un absurdo, Dios sigue llamando a quien quiere, otorgando a través del Sacramento del Orden, la misión de servir en nombre y representación de Cristo-Cabeza en medio de la comunidad. A toda la Iglesia le urge responder a esta llamada.

programme.title: Mientras el mundo gira
programme.desc: Los modales son buenas costumbres y cortesía, son las acciones, posturas y comportamientos externos con los que una persona demuestra respeto, educación y refinamiento hacia los demás. El saludar al llegar, dar las gracias, pedir permiso o escuchar sin interrumpir, son ejemplos básicos. El Padre Willie nos advierte que la falta de ellos causa desaprobación social. Los modales son como una caricia, no han pasado de moda, solo que están escasos.

programme.title: Conozca primero su fe católica
programme.sub-title: Ante la superstición: ¡Sólo Jesús tiene poder!
programme.desc: El Padre Pedro nos explica que la superstición nos lleva a poner nuestra confianza en cosas o personas que, en sí, no tienen poder alguno. La superstición es, por lo tanto, una desviación de la fe en el Único que tiene poder para darnos vida nueva y vida abundante, y ese es Jesucristo. Además responde a las preguntas llegadas al programa vía telefónica, el correo electrónico (padrepedro@ewtn.com) y Facebook (www.facebook.com/ppedronunez).

programme.title: Perspectiva Católica
programme.desc: En una época en la que la bandera de la libertad parece flamear casi en todas partes, se dan cada vez más y más atropellos en contra de la libertad de vivencia y profesión de la fe. Magdalena Lira, directora nacional de ACN (Ayuda a la Iglesia que sufre) en Chile, nos ofrece un panorama de la situación en el país, que se encuentra en observación en materia de libertad religiosa.

programme.title: Informe provida

programme.desc: En este programa nos uniremos en oración por la defensa de la vida, inspirados en el legado del Beato Fulton J. Sheen y su profunda devoción a la Hora Santa. A través de la adoración eucarística y la oración por los niños por nacer, reflexionaremos sobre la importancia de interceder por quienes se encuentran en peligro de aborto, confiando en el poder de la oración y en la misericordia de Dios.

programme.title: Informe provida
programme.sub-title: Cuando la desesperación tiene una salida
programme.desc: En este programa nos uniremos en oración por la defensa de la vida, inspirados en el legado del Beato Fulton J. Sheen y su profunda devoción a la Hora Santa. A través de la adoración eucarística y la oración por los niños por nacer, reflexionaremos sobre la importancia de interceder por quienes se encuentran en peligro de aborto, confiando en el poder de la oración y en la misericordia de Dios.

programme.title: Vaticano
programme.desc: Esta semana en Vaticano, exploramos el camino cristiano hacia la eternidad. Desde las antiguas catacumbas de Roma, donde los primeros cristianos sepultaban a sus difuntos y proclamaban su esperanza en la vida después de la muerte, hasta el Dicasterio de las Causas de los Santos, donde la Iglesia sigue presentando a hombres y mujeres de virtudes heroicas como modelos de santidad, descubrimos qué significa vivir con el cielo como destino último. También conversamos con un capellán de hospital sobre el sacramento de la Unción de los Enfermos y visitamos el Museo de las Almas del Purgatorio para profundizar en la enseñanza de la Iglesia sobre el purgatorio y en la esperanza que une a vivos y difuntos.

programme.desc: Serie original de EWTN en la que Michael O’Neill, el “Cazador del Milagros”, viaja por el mundo para darnos a conocer eventos extraordinarios ocurridos a lo largo de la historia.

programme.title: Tertulias de fe
programme.desc: El Padre Gerardo Mendoza es un sacerdote de la Diócesis de San Bernardino que fue ordenado en julio de 1988 y cuenta con casi cuatro décadas de trayectoria pastoral en el sur de California. A lo largo de su ministerio, ha servido como párroco en iglesias de ciudades como Norco e Indio, donde la comunidad hispana lo reconoce por su calidez y su guía espiritual. Además de su labor en las parroquias, ayudó a fundar en 2011 el capítulo en español del movimiento católico Magnificat con la aprobación del obispo de la región.

programme.title: Cocina franciscana
programme.desc: Hoy usamos una hortaliza poco conocida en España, el sayote. Con ella elaboramos un tartar de sayote con salmón. Aprovechamos este vídeo para hablar de la festividad de la Vírgen de la Inmaculada y de Duns Scoto, un humilde fraile franciscano que defendió la Inmaculada Concepción hasta hacerla Dogma de la Iglesia Católica.

programme.title: Santo Rosario
programme.desc: En los Misterios Gloriosos meditamos sobre la vida de Jesús desde la Resurrección del Señor hasta la Coronación de la Santísima Virgen María.

programme.title: Mientras el mundo gira
programme.desc: Los modales son buenas costumbres y cortesía, son las acciones, posturas y comportamientos externos con los que una persona demuestra respeto, educación y refinamiento hacia los demás. El saludar al llegar, dar las gracias, pedir permiso o escuchar sin interrumpir, son ejemplos básicos. El Padre Willie nos advierte que la falta de ellos causa desaprobación social. Los modales son como una caricia, no han pasado de moda, solo que están escasos.

programme.title: Conozca primero su fe católica
programme.sub-title: Ante la superstición: ¡Sólo Jesús tiene poder!
programme.desc: El Padre Pedro nos explica que la superstición nos lleva a poner nuestra confianza en cosas o personas que, en sí, no tienen poder alguno. La superstición es, por lo tanto, una desviación de la fe en el Único que tiene poder para darnos vida nueva y vida abundante, y ese es Jesucristo. Además responde a las preguntas llegadas al programa vía telefónica, el correo electrónico (padrepedro@ewtn.com) y Facebook (www.facebook.com/ppedronunez).

programme.title: Perspectiva Católica
programme.desc: En una época en la que la bandera de la libertad parece flamear casi en todas partes, se dan cada vez más y más atropellos en contra de la libertad de vivencia y profesión de la fe. Magdalena Lira, directora nacional de ACN (Ayuda a la Iglesia que sufre) en Chile, nos ofrece un panorama de la situación en el país, que se encuentra en observación en materia de libertad religiosa.

programme.title: Vaticano
programme.desc: Esta semana en Vaticano, exploramos el camino cristiano hacia la eternidad. Desde las antiguas catacumbas de Roma, donde los primeros cristianos sepultaban a sus difuntos y proclamaban su esperanza en la vida después de la muerte, hasta el Dicasterio de las Causas de los Santos, donde la Iglesia sigue presentando a hombres y mujeres de virtudes heroicas como modelos de santidad, descubrimos qué significa vivir con el cielo como destino último. We learn that God called Abraham to be a new Adam and Sarah a new Eve, with promises of descendants, wealth, and greatness. Jacob's encounter with the stone prophecy reveals the manifestation of the Father, Son, and Holy Spirit. These interconnected tales point to the ultimate Messiah.

programme.title: American Trends & Lifestyle Episode 14
programme.desc: This week on American Trends & Lifestyle, our new host Lauren Makk gets into the Halloween spirit with a look at Orlando’s seasonal fun and steps into the magical world of Willy Wonka. Plus, Trans-Siberian Orchestra celebrates 30 years of rocking the holidays, author Nathan Moris shares tips for meaningful life changes, and we go behind the scenes of the adventure thriller Heart of the Beast. We’ll also share important information to help those living with asthma better understand and manage their condition.

programme.title: Coffee with America Episode 639
programme.desc: This week on an all-new episode of Coffee with America, host Sasha Rionda celebrates fall with a coastal California getaway and smart strategies for navigating the season’s biggest sales. This prestigious event will showcase the top climbers in the country as they compete in three disciplines: Boulder, Lead, and Speed. The two highest-ranked U.S. athletes will earn a coveted spot on the U.S. National Team for 2024, allowing them to compete on the IFSC World Cup circuit. Some may even have the chance to compete in the Olympic Qualifying Series, where they will vie for additional spots on Team USA.

programme.title: Beneath The Ice
programme.desc: A story of curiosity, exploration and climate research inside the Greenland ice cap. Canadian adventurer, Will Gadd, uses his ice climbing skills to lead a scientific expedition into a previously unexplored territory beneath the ice sheet.

programme.title: Essential Self-Rescue for Climbers: Rappelling and Passing Knots CLIMB 18 | Outside Learn
programme.desc: Learn basic self-rescue skills, and how to think critically in a climbing emergency. In this episode, guide and search-and-rescue pro Karsten Delap teaches you how to rappel in different situations as well as pass the knot in an emergency.

programme.title: Speaking out Against Bullying
programme.desc: Sasha DiGiulian's Tuesday plans are turned upside down when she has to return from a climbing trip to Nice in order to see her grandmother before she passes. During an already trying week, Sasha is tested by cyber bullying and makes the courageous choice to address the issue head on.

programme.title: 2024 Paraclimbing Finals: Session One | USA Climbing
programme.desc: Paraclimbing Finals: Session One from Gaithersburg, MD. USA Climbing will hold the 2024 Paraclimbing Nationals Championships on March 9-10 at Sportrock Climbing Center Rio in Gaithersburg, MD. Paraclimbing National Championships will be a two-round competition hosting a modified redpoint qualification round on day one and an onsight final round on day two. The climbing will be executed on top rope.

programme.title: Intro to Trad: Safe Descents CLIMB 14 | Outside Learn
programme.desc: Ease your way into trad climbing, and safely open up a ton of new terrain for you and your partner. In this episode, IFMGA guides Rob Coppolillo and Marc Chauvin take you through rappelling, lowering, and how to handle special situations.

programme.title: International Paralympic Committee Selects 2028 Medal Events
programme.desc: Reporting on the recent International Paralympic Committee's announcement of its choice medal events in the upcoming 2028 inaugural Paralympic climbing competitions. Some selections/omissions were surprising to Paralympic hopefuls. Voiceover from Climbing contributor Suzie Hodges Irby, footage from IFSC paraclimbing competitions, and remote interviews with athletes Emeline Lakrout, Mo Beck, and Ben Mayforth.

programme.title: Episode 7 | Weekend Whipper | Singularity
programme.desc: In a UGC clip, climber Mou Ding is on "Singularity" (5.12b) when his second-to-last draw pops out of his rope. Jeff Jaramillo, Head of Gear Education and Outreach at Weigh My Rack, reacts to the clip and offers his takeaways over a remote video interview, pointing out the open gate in the carabiner, as seen in the footage.

programme.title: 2025 National Team Trials: Lead Semi-Finals | USA Climbing
programme.desc: The 2025 National Team Trials: Lead Semi-Finals. The 2025 National Team Trials Presented by YETI kick off in Mesa Rim in Austin, TX! 117 registered athletes will compete for spots on the Boulder, Lead, and Speed National Teams, with the opportunity to represent the USA at international World Cups.

programme.title: 2025 National Team Trials: Boulder Finals | USA Climbing
programme.desc: The 2025 National Team Trials: Boulder Finals. The 2025 National Team Trials Presented by YETI kick off in Mesa Rim in Austin, TX! 117 registered athletes will compete for spots on the Boulder, Lead, and Speed National Teams, with the opportunity to represent the USA at international World Cups.

programme.title: First Female Ascent and Exploration in Cuba
programme.desc: Sasha and friends are in Cuba for some jungle sport climbing!

programme.title: Beckett Hsin Sends V17 at 16 Years Old
programme.desc: Last week, on February 24, 16-year-old Beckett Hsin became the youngest person in the world to send the hardest confirmed grade in bouldering when he topped out on No One Mourns the Wicked (V17) in Thunder Ridge, Colorado. Here, he discusses his "boulder his age" challenge that he started when he was just 12 years old.

programme.title: Are You a Dancer or a Fighter?
programme.desc: Climbing Coach Casey Elliot explains that there are two types of climbers: the try-hard, onsighting Fighters and the meticulous, projecting Dancers. Casey explains how he and his "Dancer" climbing friend came up with this revelation and gives the advice that pushing yourself to channel both styles of climbing will help you become a more balanced climber.

programme.title: Climbing Holds... Made Out of Mushrooms
programme.desc: Climbing Editor-in-Chief Maya Silver recounts speaking with Marta Agueda and Manuela Garcia, the founders of MAD, about their sustainable climbing holds made out of the roots of mushrooms in Berlin. As approximately 7 million plastic climbing holds end up in the landfill every year, these European game changers are forging a more sustainable path for the future of gyms. Read the full story here: https://www.climbing.com/culture-climbing/sustainable-climbing-holds-mushrooms-bioresins-recycled-plastic/

programme.title: Climbing's Newest Hotbed | No Days Off
programme.desc: Sasha travels to Manikia, a small village in Greece, to experience an emerging climbing destination. Manikia has only recently come into the spotlight as a potential world-class climbing destination. Sasha is joined on this adventure by fellow climbers from the Petzl team. The ultimate goal is to help establish a new climbing area the right way. During this trip, Sasha and the team set new routes in calibration with local climbers and guides while discussing ecotourism's positive and negative effects on local communities.

programme.title: How to Make a Solid Tape Glove
programme.desc: Professional climber and Climbing Contributor Genevive Walker demonstrates how to make a quality tape glove to use while crack climbing. She includes pro tips like the fact that tape gloves can be reused, if the tape is removed carefully!

programme.title: How to Climb in the Steeps
programme.desc: Climbing Contributor and professional climber Genevive Walker gives tips and tricks for climbing in the steeps, demonstrating proper foot placement, core engagement, and more.

programme.title: Episode 6 | Weekend Whipper | Ripping Cams in a Swedish Finger Crack
programme.desc: Climber Fay Manners takes a fall on "Trampoline"(5.11b) in Bohuslän, Sweden, in this week's Weekend Whipper, ripping out a cam in a finger crack.

programme.title: A Guide to Climber Skincare
programme.desc: Professional climber and Climbing contributor Genevive Walker does a show-and-tell with her favorite skincare products that are useful for climbers. She covers antihydral, Rhino Dry spray, Rhino Split+ (a hyaluronic acid cream), Rhino Spit (an aloe-based spray), Rhino Repair, and the importance of tape and of filing down calluses.

programme.title: How I Deal with the Fear of Falling in the Gym
programme.desc: Avianna Frady, Instagram-popular climber @climbwithavi, shares how she deals with the fear of falling in the gym. Falling can be intimidating, especially during dynos, but she makes herself practice falling so that she gets comfortable with it and can try big moves.

programme.title: The Blind Ascensionist
programme.desc: At 14, Justin Salas lost his vision but not his inner drive for adventure. This thrill seeker will take us on a journey of learning to navigate our world legally blind while pushing past any barrier or boulder in his way en route to becoming a World Champion Climber who continues to pursue a new challenge at every turn. Through Justin’s narration, viewers will be drawn into his mindset as he navigates through his physical, mental, and emotional barriers, only to find the strength to push past any “boulders” put in front of him. When Justin lost sight, climbing helped him build resilience and relationships as he found his place in the world as a blind young adult, and now he shows the world how he sees it.

programme.title: Climbing Switzerland’s Luzzone Dam
programme.desc: Two women climb the tallest artificial climbing route in the world, the Luzzone Dam. Standing at 541 feet tall, the dam is great for those experienced in multi-pitch routes, or can be top-roped by booking a guide. The climb is described as exposed and ridiculously fun with great views. Get the full guide to climbing the dam here: https://www.climbing.com/travel/climbing-luzzone-dam/

programme.title: Grim Ripper: The Scariest Gear Fails
programme.desc: In this Halloween-themed episode of Weekend Whipper, a bunch of climbers scream as they take giant falls, the result of various gear failures.

programme.title: YETI Climbing National Championships 2026 - Boulder Semi-Finals | USA Climbing
programme.desc: The USA Climbing 2026 National Championships for Youth (YETI Nationals) at High Point Climbing and Fitness in Orlando, FL, bringing together top young climbers for Boulder, Lead, and Speed events to crown national champions and select athletes for national teams, showcasing Florida's competitive climbing scene.

programme.title: The Future of Fashion | No Days Off
programme.desc: Sasha meets up with professional Kiteboarder and swimwear designer Sensi Graves to hear what makes Sensi's business specializing in fashion. Sensi Graves is a self-made entrepreneur who started her sustainable swimwear brand - her materials are made from 100% recycled ocean plastics and reclaimed fishing nets. To round out this Oregon adventure and get the whole Hood River experience, Sasha and Sensi decide to trade sports for a day - Sasha tries kiteboarding for the first time, and Sensi tries her hand at climbing.

programme.title: Inside the Brazilian Climber Girl's Van-Meets-Gear-Closet
programme.desc: Professional climber and climbing guide Gisely Ferraz (@brazilianclimbergirl on her popular Instagram account) shows how she optimizes her camper van to store her climbing gear.

programme.title: Peak Exclusive Trailer
programme.desc: An exclusive clip of Peak, a cooperative climbing video game published by Aggro Crab and Landfall, is available on Steam. The game supports up to four players, and the goal is to get to the top of a mountain after crash landing on an island.

programme.title: Yoga for Climbers: Yoga to Prevent Injuries and Control Breathing CLIMB 25 | Outside Learn
programme.desc: Whether you're a veteran big waller, casual gym climber, or just getting started, doing yoga will help you send. In this episode, pro climber and yoga instructor Heidi Wirtz will help prevent injuries and control your breathing.

programme.title: Training and Cooking at Home
programme.desc: Sasha DiGiulian returns to Boulder from Toronto. She works out at home and shows us a new green juice recipe.

programme.title: 2 Skills to Prevent Multi-pitch Accidents
programme.desc: Climbing contributor Nathan Conroy walks viewers through the SERENE method of building a trad anchor. He demonstrates how to rappel without a belay device using three locking carabiners and a prussik. Read the story: https://www.climbing.com/skills/multi-pitch-techniques-to-prevent-accidents-and-get-yourself-off-the-wall/

programme.title: Episode 11, Weekend Whipper: Slab Slide
programme.desc: This Weekend Whipper features a UGC clip of an slab free climbing fall, saved only by grabbing onto an anchor further down the route.

programme.title: Climbing in Boulder
programme.desc: Sasha DiGiulian spends the morning in Boulder working Thunder Muscle, a 5.14a nestled between the Flatirons. Then she races back to town, packs a bag and catches a flight to San Francisco for a photoshoot with her newest sponsor, Tiger Balm.

programme.title: Dear Mother
programme.desc: Climber and transracial Asian-American, Cody Kaemmerlen, searches for a connection with his birth parents after a near-death fall leaves him shaken and grasping for answers.

programme.title: Veronica Chik - 'Fish Eye' (8c)
programme.desc: Nine-year-old Chinese climber Veronica Chik sends 'Fish Eye' (5.14b; 8c) in Oliana Spain, becoming the world's youngest person to successfully climb the grade. Watch Chik send the route and talk about her love of the sport.

programme.title: Episode 17, Weekend Whipper: Falling Climber Gets Saved at the Last Second
programme.desc: In this Weekend Whipper, climber Avery Lieu falls while climbing Scary Monsters (5.12a) in Joshua Tree National Park, hitting the rope on the way down.

programme.title: Red Flags: Bolts and Fixed Anchors
programme.desc: Chris Brown, Pro Anchor Maintenance Crew at Salt Lake Climbers Alliance, explains what he looks for when performing maintenance on bolts and fixed anchors. He uses a magnet to test the metal, and looks to see if there is rust, corrosion, bending, or if an anchor is loose. Stainless steel glue-in bolts are the new highest quality standard.

programme.title: The Sport Climbing Fall That Led to a Thumb Amputation
programme.desc: Sam Macllwaine, Associate Editor at Climbing Magazine and Jeff Jaramillo, Head of Outreach & Gear Education at WeighMyRack discuss a climbing accident and how to avoid injuries. Mylee Lorenz, a climber, fell while clipping, and got a rope wrapped around her thumb, resulting in an amputation. Jeff explains scenarios that could have cause this and what to do instead. He says to make sure there isn’t a twist in the rope, not to back clip, and not to grab for a rope when you fall.

programme.title: Episode 18, Weekend Whipper: Your Screams Won’t Save You

programme.desc: Big wave surfer Ross Clarke-Jones is passionate about speed. Ross Clarke-Jones charges at everything head-on. As Tom puts it, RCJ has an itch he has to scratch -- going as fast as possible.

programme.title: Ben Matson Predicts the Biggest Waves On Earth | Storm Surfers
programme.desc: Surf forecaster Ben Matson opens up about his company and love for forecasting. He discusses the challenges that come with the job since the weather and how he has devoted his life working 7 days a week to give surfers the information they need.

programme.title: LOCALS: Angel Collinson in Salt Lake City
programme.desc: Angel Collinson, world-class skier, calls Salt Lake City, Utah home. Leaving the crowded tourist hubs, we join Collinson and Erik Roner on an adventure through the Utah backcountry.

programme.title: Game of S.K.A.T.E. - Wakeskate vs. Skateboard
programme.desc: Skateboarding and wakeskating are very similar sports. But with Matti Buys on the wakeskate, and Jean-Marc Johannes skateboarding on the dock, which sport would win in a classic game of S.K.A.T.E.?

programme.title: Mountainous Trail Running in Scotland
programme.desc: The Forge - This video is about trail and wilderness running in the far NW of Scotland, on and around An Teallach.

programme.title: On The Road With Rickey Gates | Salomon TV
programme.desc: At 19, Rickey Gates dropped out of college and headed on a road trip to South America. It was a trip that would kick-start a life of adventure and travel.

programme.title: The Original | Salomon TV
programme.desc: In 1974 Gordy Ainsleigh competed against the horses in a 100 Mile trail ride through the Sierra Nevada mountains... on foot. This single event led to the birth of one of the most famous 100 mile footraces in the world, The Western States 100.

programme.title: Running Above the Arctic Circle | Salomon Running:
programme.desc: Emelie Forsberg only emerged onto the trail running scene in 2012. In just a couple of years she has established herself as one of best trail runners in the world. In the final episode of Season 03 we head up north, above the Arctic Circle.

programme.title: The Van Life: Travis Burke
programme.desc: Traveling to remote locations, hiking for hours, hanging from a 500 foot bridge, living in a van for months on end and staying up all night to get a shot are all a regular part of Travis Burke's life. http://www.travisburkephotography.com

programme.title: 7-Way Wingsuit BASE Jump
programme.desc: A 7-way wingsuit BASE off the Cliffs in the American South West. This group of friends and experienced wingsuit pilots explore the beautiful landscape of cactus, sand, red rock towers and deep blue sky.

programme.title: Live Every Minute
programme.desc: During our life span, every minute of every hour is a gift.....an opportunity to experience.... to share passion..... to be inspired. Each year, there are 8760 hours to live KAVU. Get out there and make em count.

programme.title: The Barrel 12: Bali Groms
programme.desc: Check out what skipping a day from school looks like when you are lucky enough to live in Bali…

programme.title: Why We Run | Salomon TV
programme.desc: Bernd Heinrich is a retired Professor living in a log cabin in the woods of Western Maine. He has held numerous running records throughout his life and has committed much of his time to the study of the natural world.

programme.title: Ultrarunner Anna Frost Returns to New Zealand | Salomon TV
programme.desc: Home - Anna Frost has spent the past 8 years wandering the globe competing in some of the worlds top trail races. In this episode Anna reconnects with her identity and roots as she questions what running means to her.

programme.title: Roots | Salomon TV
programme.desc: Francois D'haene is one of the world's best ultra trail runners. In the past 2 years he has won the UTMB®, La Diagonale des fous and the Mont Blanc 80km. He is also the winemaker at the Domaine du Germain vineyard in the Beaujolais region of France.

programme.title: Hartman Rector - Loves to Fly
programme.desc: A highlight of Hartman Rector flying all over the world. From Utah to Europe Hartman is always smiling, flying high and buzzin' hard on life. #BUZZNARD

programme.title: Running Scotland's Notorious An Teallach "The Forge"
programme.desc: This video is about trail and wilderness running in the far NW of Scotland, on and around An Teallach 'The Forge.'

programme.title: San Juans | Proven Here
programme.desc: In late fall, we traveled to the high elevations of the San Juan mountains to explore the vast range and to test out our prototype suspension platform.

programme.title: NeilPryde Windsurfing 2014

programme.title: The Emerald Isle: Surfing Ireland

programme.title: Into the Thicket | Sitka
programme.desc: Into the Thicket chronicles the journey of a few skateboarders' treck into the forests of Vancouver Island to skate a ramp constructed using the surrounding environment and few other materials.

programme.title: Marshall Miller: Ski-Base to Parking Lot
programme.desc: Marshall Miller shows us the fast way to the parking lot. The GoPro Bomb Squad member and Team KAVU Athlete hucks a huge ski-base and floats a smooth truck-driver front flip.

programme.title: Cuba Kitesurf Paradise
programme.desc: Cayo Guillermo. It's the perfect place if you want to kite in front of your hotel. You can just pump your kites in front of your room and then jump in the blue lagoon! If you want a flat spot you just have to go behind in the mangrove.

programme.title: Sean O'Brien 50 Mile Race
programme.desc: On February 1, 2014 some of ultrarunning's finest men and women toed the line for the inaugural Sean O'Brien 50 Miler, a Montrail Ultra Cup race.

programme.title: Skyliners: The Balloon Highline
programme.desc: Amazing! They put up a line between two hot air balloons to try their first completely movable highline.

programme.title: Jonny Durand sets two hang gliding world records

programme.desc: Cinematography by:Vincent Kardasik and Pietro Franca SURFERS:Benjamin Sanchis,Tom Butler,Peter Conroy,Caino Chuillinn,Francois Liets,Barry Mottershead and Conor Maguiree

programme.title: Highline Hong Kong
programme.desc: HK's first highline, set and walked during the 2013 Mid-Autumn Festival.

programme.title: Hannah Kearney: Whack - A - Mogul
programme.desc: Since first putting on skis at the age of two in her hometown of Norwich, VT, Hannah has competed in two Olympic Winter Games.

programme.title: Polar Vortex: Ice Castles
programme.desc: Instead of carving ice to create these castles, they place sprinkler heads in a well thought out manner, and position icicles in such a way that the water continues to grow the icicles - taller and wider.

programme.title: Bouldering in Malawi // The Warm Heart Of Africa
programme.desc: We had the chance to visit South Africa to film bouldering in Rocklands. While bouldering there is amazing, we could not help but ask ourselves if there was good bouldering in other parts of Africa. With only satellite imagery from Google Earth as information, we decided to bet on the small, overlooked country of Malawi. This Summer, climbers Mélissa Le Nevé and Benjamin Rueck flew to Malawi, knowing almost nothing about the country. They quickly discovered why the country is called "The Warm Heart of Africa".

programme.title: A-Line
programme.desc: A few years back Mason Mashon and friend Steven Matthews rode a quick top to bottom on Whistler’s A-line bike trail. Seven months later the Cohn brothers skied the same line covered by a little more snow.

programme.title: Ramón Navarro - Surfing Antarctica
programme.desc: The constant seek of Ramón Navarro for big waves in Chilean coasts take him to his maximum adventure; the challenge to travel to the most austral spot of the world and became the first man to practice Tow-in in the white continent.

programme.title: Nick Goepper - Trick Breakdown
programme.desc: Watch young freeski prodigy Nick Goepper as he breaks down his winning freeskiing tricks along with his training routine to keep him on the podium.

programme.title: The Barrel 9: Surf's Elite at Pipeline
programme.desc: While the holiday season was all about turkey for many, the iON the Barrel crew were busy filming and many of the world's surfing elite were charging Pipeline on Oahu's fabled North Shore. Santa brought sacksful of epic swells and the Pipeline Masters and Triple Crown delivered in spades to a packed beach. The Barrel brings you some of the highlights and applauds monster pits by Mick Fanning, Kelly Slater, and JJF.

programme.title: The Barrel 8: Breathtaking Surf Photos From Around the Globe
programme.desc: The winners from the online competition at www.surfthebarrel.com. Check out the rides, photos and clips that earned these winners a week of empty waves up at Papatura Island Retreat in the Solomon Islands.

programme.title: The Barrel 7
programme.desc: iON the Barrel celebrates the winners from the online competition at www.surfthebarrel.com in this wrap up from 2013. Check out the rides, photos and clips that earned these winners a week of empty waves up at Papatura Island Retreat in the Solomon Islands. This 'Grind' keeps to the trusted barrel theme with lashings of hollow waves and good times from wherever waves tube around the globe. Take in some highlights from the iON the Barrel film including some stunning rides from Hawaii, Tahiti, Kirra and Indonesia.

programme.title: Pastranaland Ep 6 - Best of Pastranaland from the SkyVue
programme.desc: You can subscribe with one click for more insane action: We saved the best, unbelievable aerial footage for the last episode of the Pastranaland series.

programme.title: Canada's Skier Paradise | Season Pass
programme.desc: Skiers Bryce Phillips, Phil Meier, Stain Hagen, and Andrea Binning look to British Columbia for late season snow in Canada's skiers paradise. But even in paradise danger lurks.

programme.title: Outside Film Festival: Down the Line
programme.desc: A handful of dedicated Vancouverites are bringing a new sport to their local mountains, a sport that has always been linked exclusively to Utah and the Alps: Canyoneering.

programme.title: Icelight Toronto
programme.desc: I was home over the holidays in Toronto during the epic ice storm of 2013 and I managed to bundle up and face the insanely cold temperatures to get some timelapses and document the damage.

programme.title: Grand Trunk: A Love Affair with Adventure
programme.desc: People have a love affair with adventure. We feel it inside like a current in the wind, and it drives us to step outside the ordinary.

programme.title: Cerro Torre - A Snowballs Chance in Hell
programme.desc: After more than three years of trying, David finally realised his dream of becoming the first person to free climb the infamous Compressor Route on Patagonia's Cerro Torre.

programme.title: Nepal Trials
programme.desc: He does things with a bike that will blow your mind in these bike trials in Nepal.

programme.title: Crankworx Rhapsody Slopestyle
programme.desc: Staged in the “Boneyard,” the dirt stadium at the base of the Whistler Mountain Bike Park, Rhapsody Slopestyle offers the best Slopestyle mountain bikers on the planet two runs – that’s two chances for glory, two opportunities to throw down high-scoring tricks and move up the leader board, and two moments in time to leave their mark on the history of the sport. The 18 best riders in the world bring their A-game to this invitational showcase, interpreting a custom-built course and giving it their all.

programme.title: Crankworx Mont-Sainte-Anne Downhill
programme.desc: Watch the world's top riders compete on this legendary downhill track in the inaugural Crankworx Mont-Sainte-Anne festival. This world-famous race is the final stop of the 2026 Crankworx Downhill series and will test riders in the ultimate battle of speed, technique, and courage. The track features a steep, long and demanding descent, dotted with rocks, roots and impressive jumps, all in front of a roaring crowd of MTB fans.

programme.title: Crankworx Mont-Sainte-Anne Slopestyle
programme.desc: After 8 months of competition around the globe, the inaugural Slopestyle Super League (SSL) Finals have arrived. The Top 10 Men and Top 5 Women from the Season and Playoffs are going head to head for a chance to be crowned the first-ever SSL World Champion. A flagship discipline of the Crankworx World Tour, this is the first time a Slopestyle competition will be held in not only Mont-Sainte-Anne but also in Quebec at the elite level. Larger-than-life jumps and spectacular tricks, all performed with a heavy dose of steeze.

programme.title: The Year Red Bull Hardline Was Cancelled: What Really Happened?
programme.desc: Being a World Cup racer isn't just about racing the best of the best at the international series.
