programme.desc: The Crankworx World Tour is a premier multi-stop series of mountain bike festivals, uniting top-tier athletes from around the globe to compete in elite-level competitions across a variety of disciplines. In 2025, Crankworx proudly celebrates 20 years of the ultimate experience in mountain biking! Crankworx Summer Series offers a platform for local and international riders to race within the Crankworx framework in emerging mountain bike destinations. Returning stronger than ever after the 2024 cancellation due to the Port Hills fire, the festival welcomes a star-studded lineup of athletes to Christchurch Adventure Park. Fans can watch their local heroes and international heavy hitters compete in the FMB Gold Cup Slopestyle, the Redemption Downhill, and Christchurch Pump Track. All events are available live on Outside TV and Pinkbike.

programme.title: Warren Miller's Freeriders (1998)
programme.desc: “Freeriders,” embarks on its national tour from October through December and spans the globe in search of freedom. “Freeriders” captures the essence of freedom as world-class skiers and snowboarders hit the slopes in spectacular style. Warren Miller, the seventy-three year old master of cutting-edge sports films, compares “Freeriders” with “the freedom of first tracks — where your most basic instinct, your instinctive search for freedom, is finally being satisfied.” To complement all of the hard-hitting action, “Freeriders” blends extraordinary cinematography with the trademark wit of Warren Miller. Along with the refreshing voices of the film’s athletes, “Freeriders” continues to feature Warren Miller’s traditional and poignant narration that have made him a legend in the world of entertainment.

programme.title: Mountain Division

programme.title: Warren Miller's Future Retro (2020)
programme.desc: If there is one thing you can always count on, even in a year like 2020, it is Warren Miller's annual ski film. And this year is no different. Warren Miller’s Future Retro will revel in 71 years of movie magic—with fresh stories and perspectives from across the globe, heroes from the glory days, and that retro energy keeping the winter dream alive. Travel to Switzerland with big-mountain skiers Lexi duPont and Amie Engerbreston. Explore Iceland with Aspen locals Victor Major and Baker Boyd. Go to Antarctica to closely examine the impact of climate change while seeking adventure with Protect Our Winters and athletes Elana Hight, Danny Davis and Nick Russell. And celebrate the legacy of ski pioneers like the Egan brothers, while ushering in young guns like Parkin Costain and Jack and Maria Lovely. You can’t look toward the future without taking a look back at the past. Future Retro will be that connection—past, present and future. Join the collective experience, which includes resort and retail offers from local and national partners, this fall as the legacy continues.

programme.title: Warren Miller's Here, There & Everywhere (2016)
programme.desc: It’s been 67 years since ski-film pioneer Warren Miller first picked up a camera to capture the wonder, adventure, humor, and beauty that is skiing. Since that time, Warren Miller film crews have traveled the globe—from storied slopes to hidden, snow-covered corners—to celebrate all things snowsports. Their quest has taken powder-hungry filmgoers, Here, There & Everywhere—and this year continues that legacy. This fall, witness a freeform, freeski adventure in Warren Miller Entertainment’s 67th snowsports film, Here, There & Everywhere. See JT Holmes, Jeremy Jones, Grete Eliassen, Collin Collins, Ingrid Backstrom, Tyler Ceccanti, Wendy Fisher and more as they sweep across the expanses of Alaska, Montana’s Glacier Country, Deer Valley, Greenland, Switzerland and more in the pursuit of the perfect turns. This year, don’t miss Warren Miller himself spin tales of the past as only Warren can do, reminding us that through the years, these films have truly taken audiences Here, There & Everywhere.

programme.title: Gentle Landscapes: Part 1
programme.desc: Gentle Landscapes: Part 1

programme.title: Warren Miller's Higher Ground (2005)
programme.desc: Warren Miller’s HIGHER GROUND, an independent movie slated to visit theatres across the U.S. from October through December 2005, chronicles skiers and snowboarders in their never-ending search for new and thrilling ways to ride the snow. Crisscrossing the globe, hitting the steeps of Alaska, terrain parks in Colorado, deep powder in British Columbia and cliffs in Switzerland, Warren Miller’s HIGHER GROUND brings skiing and snowboarding to life on the big screen as no other action sports film has done before as the country’s first-ever high-definition film tour. Part action/adventure, part documentary, Warren Miller’s HIGHER GROUND also features legendary athletes such as big mountain skiers Jeremy Nobis and Seth Morrison, Ski-BASE jumping innovator Shane McConkey, and the sport’s hot-dogging icon, Glen Plake, as well as up and coming stars like five-year-old phenom Bridger Gile.

programme.title: Warren Miller's Impact (2004)
programme.desc: Celebrate the onset of winter and the thrill of action sports with IMPACT, the 55th annual Warren Miller movie, as it tours the country making stops in 250 cities from October through December, 2004. IMPACT showcases winter sports’ top athletes and local heroes on the big screen as they travel to fabled and exotic locations around the globe in search of the perfect ride, deepest powder and sickest lines. Each screening of the movie is a high-energy live event booked as a limited engagement, often for one night only.

programme.title: Going for Gold
programme.desc: The US Ski and Snowboard teams have done well in recent years. Much of the success is a result of superstars like Bode Miller, Shawn White, and Lindsey Vonn. In this episode of Season Pass we look to the next generation of US hopefuls.

programme.title: High Risk High Reward
programme.desc: When youre pushing the limits of skiing and riding, it can be risky business but these athletes know that a few close calls are part of the game when youre after the ultimate reward.

programme.title: Road Tripping
programme.desc: From Montana to Alaska and across the pond to Norway, athletes track down perfect conditions by any mode of transportation necessary to be in the right place at the right time.

programme.title: Extending the Season
programme.desc: Skiers search for an endless winter by heading south to Portillo, Chile, way north to Svalbard, Norway and up to the glaciers of Alaska.

programme.title: Warren Miller's In Search Of Skiing (1977)
programme.desc: We’re all searching for something but the real question is what. For people like Scott Miller, John Clendenin, Dave Clark, Bob Burns, Bab Salerno, and countless others well they’re all In Search of Skiing. Warren Miller takes you back to some of the most original and earliest forms of skiing and extreme skiing. Take a ski trip from Switzerland to Morocco, over to Spain, and across the pond to Maine and Canada and find out for yourself if you’re one of the many people out there In Search of Skiing.

programme.title: Warren Miller's Journey (2003)
programme.desc: From the legendary filmmaking company comes an all-new film packed with incredible action cinematography from around the globe. Loyal Warren Miller fans will be lured by this film’s new heights in powder, cliffs and exotic locations, a formula that induces seven out of ten audience members to return annually. JOURNEY delivers the very best of this year’s skiing and riding, fusing terrain park progression with the backcountry, and technical lines with endless powder shots. Warren Miller camera crews chase the snow year round. JOURNEY takes viewers along for the ride in the quest for perfect conditions from Aspen to Chile and Alaska to Morocco. Journey across four continents with 19 film crews and 73 athletes--including icons Glen Plake, Bode Miller, and Terje Haakonsen--for the adventure of a lifetime. JOURNEY also includes a tribute to an athlete who pioneered the sport of snowboarding - Craig Kelly. Whether riding rails in Breckenridge or skiing with best friends in Chamonix, this year's film shows that it's not about the destination; it's about the journey.

programme.title: Warren Miller's Like There's No Tomorrow (2011)
programme.desc: Watch world-class athletes – including Chris Davenport, Julia Mancuso, Daron Rahlves, Colby West and Seth Wescott – drop lines most of us only see in our dreams and learn, frame-by-frame, how to live . . . Like There’s No Tomorrow. Check warrenmiller.com for a complete showcase of this year’s film locations and extended athlete bios. . . . Like There's No Tomorrow is your annual reminder that winter is on its way and, with it, an adrenaline-fueled dance with gravity. “We welcome winter with everything we've got,” explains the film’s director and producer, Max Bervy. “Because, while there’s always a tomorrow, there are only so many dawns with fresh snow.”

programme.title: The Fighting Westerner
programme.desc: A mining engineer tries to solve the murders of several heirs to a valuable radium mine in this western drama from Paramount Pictures. Stars include Charles Chic Sale, and in one of his early roles, Randolph Scott. This feature, also known as Rocky Mountain Mystery, was directed by Oscar winner Charles Barton, who would go on to direct several popular television shows, including Petticoat Junction and Family Affair...

programme.title: Death Valley
programme.desc: A love story and a search for gold in the Valley of Death! Dubbed simple, powerful and dramatic by the New York Times on the date of its release, Death Valley is indeed an elegant depiction of love and deception in the American desert during the Gold Rush. In what was to be the final film of famed silent film director Paul Powell (Polyanna), a cast of mostly unknown actors produces uniformly excellent work. Lyrical and graceful, Powells film spins the tale of a young boy who finds love and gold, only to have it stolen from him.

programme.title: Riders of the Whistling Pines
programme.desc: GENE AUTRY COMES ROARING OUT OF THE SKIES...to save the forests from an outlaw lumber ring! When ex forest ranger Gene tries to interfere with a gang destroying the timberland, hes framed for cattle-poisoning and set up for a murder charge. Yet, he still has time to sing some great cowboy songs, including Its My Lazy Day, and Hair of Gold. This is Gene Autry in a slightly different role, with some great footage filmed at Big Bear Valley and San Bernardino National Forest.

programme.title: Colorado Kid
programme.desc: Cowboy star Bob Steele (Valley of Hunted Men, The Trail Blazers) headlines this Poverty Row western drama. As the Colorado Kid, he's falsely arrested for murder and has to clear himself. The colorful cast includes Ernie Adams, Frank LaRue, and Horace Murphy, with direction by Sam Newfield (The Terror of Tiny Town, The Mad Monster).

programme.title: The Two Gun Man
programme.desc: Ken Maynard stars in this vintage western about ranchers under threat from hired gunmen. Director Phil Rosen, whose career dated back to working with Thomas Edison and included several Charlie Chan features, keeps the action hot with help from a strong ensemble, including Charles King, Murdock MacQuarrie, and a horse named Tarzan! Maynard plays Blackie Weed, a marshall going undercover to capture and arrest some cattle rustlers.He finds himself up against some very bad men, and he's soon framed for murder. Watch as Blackie blazes his way to vindication with a .45 in either hand and the flame of righteous anger in his eyes... Kitty: Nita Martin. Joe Kearney: Lafe McKee. Lem Tolliver: Tom London. Ranch Foreman: Walter Perry

programme.title: Young Bill Hickock

Starring Sally Payne as Calamity Jane, and Rogerss ongoing sidekick George Gabby Hayes, this twofisted saga relives some of Americas most colorful days, and also has time for a few musical numbers, including Up and Down the Prairie, and When the Shadows Fall Across the Rockies.

programme.title: A Lust to Kill
programme.desc: An imprisoned outlaw escapes and goes on the hunt for his brothers murderers, who just happen to be members of the outlaws own gang. He and his beloved hit the trail, but are pursued by local law enforcement, who have their own plans for justice. Starring Don Megowan, Jim Davis, and Allison Hayes.

programme.title: With Sitting Bull at the Spirit Lake Massacre
programme.desc: A long-thought-lost film finally surfaces after being unseen for over eight decades. Created and copyrighted by Sunset Productions in 1925 but not released until June 15, 1927, this silent epic features the superior Native American actor Chief Yowlachie (performing here under the name Chief Yowlache) as Sitting Bull. Other fine actors in the cast include the always popular Bryant Washburn and a young Bob Steele, who appears under his real name Bob Bradbury Jr. The story takes place in the 1860s or 1870s near Spirit Lake, Iowa. Settlements of whites are growing in that region but the Sioux Indians also have professed their interest in one such settlement. Chief Sitting Bull surveys the settlement at Spirit Lake from afar and with the advice of the Great Spirit vows to retake the land that belonged to his fathers.

When they arrive, they discover the mine has been closed, the wells are all poisoned and the town is in the grip of a malaria epidemic. To make matters worse, the lawmen have been followed by four gunslingers determined to give the American troubleshooters all the trouble they can handle - and more. Russell Hayden stars.

Fraser (The Last of the Clintons, Rustlers Paradise) directs a strong cast of familiar faces, including legendary sidekick George Gabby Hayes, Earl Dwyer, and one of the hardest ridin stuntmen turned actors, Yakima Canutt.

programme.desc: A 1957 Ford Thunderbird gets the restoration treatment with new paint, interior, and a rebuilt V8 motor.

programme.title: Fast and Famous S1 - "Fast and Famous"
programme.desc: Racing Driver Arie Luyendyk Jr. challenges two celebrities, kickboxer Rico Verhoeven and footballer Sol Campbell, to see who is the fastest around the track.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz S13 - "Perks of Being a Challenger"
programme.desc: The Ghouls give their care and attention to a Dodge Challenger, and welcome it to the next phase of its restoration.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz S13 - "The Road Runner Diaries - Part 1"
programme.desc: The Ghouls begin the 45-day restoration of a 1970 Road Runner. It's owned by tool creator Mark Martinez, who drove the car in his youth and believes it showed him his life's calling.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz S13 - "The Road Runner Diaries - Part 2"
programme.desc: The Ghouls attempt to finish the 45-day restoration of a 1970 Road Runner, owned by tool creator Mark Martinez, who can't wait to take it for its first drive.

programme.title: The Flying Kestrel S2 - "The Crash"
programme.desc: After driver Jon Webster crashes the Flying Kestrel at 148 mph, the team must work out what went wrong and have to decide if the dream of a land speed record is worth risking it all?

programme.title: The Flying Kestrel S2 - "The Rebuild"
programme.desc: The Flying Kestrel team regroup at Jon’s workshop as he shows them his new groundbreaking ideas to rebuild the car to give them the best chance at breaking a land speed record.

programme.title: The Flying Kestrel S2 - "The Test"
programme.desc: The new version of the Flying Kestrel is ready to be put to the test at one of the most state of the art wind tunnels. Has the team done enough to create a record-breaking car?

programme.title: Muscle Cars of Texas S1 - "64 Corvette resto mod"
programme.desc: Vinnie and the team at Muscle Cars of Texas take you on a tour of what is happening in the shop. Replacing the front end of a 64 Corvette resto mod. Painting racing stripes on a 67 442 convertible. A yellow Camaro underneath the hood of this car.

programme.title: Muscle Cars of Texas S1 - "442 resto mod"
programme.desc: Vinnie and the team at Muscle Cars of Texas work on gluing the front panel on the 442 Restomod. This 67 Mercury Cougar has some issues with the rear brake pads.

programme.title: Muscle Cars of Texas S1 - "1963 Corvette Z06"
programme.desc: The team at Muscle Cars of Texas will add primer to the frame of a half million dollar 1963 Corvette Z06. This 65 Mustang had a tune up and its ready for a test drive. A new costumer has dropped off a 1968 Corvette for a restoration project.

programme.title: The Ride Life with Sung Kang S1 - "United Kingdom"
programme.desc: Sung heads to the UK, home to some of the world's most iconic car brands like Land Rover, Rolls Royce, and Jaguar. It's a land rich in history, but as Sung explores the car culture's grass roots, he finds the people who make it so memorable.

programme.title: The Ride Life with Sung Kang S1 - "Poland"
programme.desc: Sung's dive into the world's car cultures takes him to Poland, a country that emerged from a repressive communist era. Sung finds that new freedoms have led to an explosion of optimist and energy, and one of the most exciting experiences of his life.

programme.title: The Ride Life with Sung Kang S1 - "Korea"
programme.desc: Despite a troubled past of poverty and invasions, Korea has emerged as a car building power-house. Through its unheralded and talented-loaded car scene, Sung reconnects with the land of his birth and finds peace with his estranged mother.

programme.title: Car Crews with Supercar Blondie S1 - "Los Angeles"
programme.desc: Supercar Blondie goes to Hollywood arriving in a million dollar V12 Ferrari. In the ‘City of Angels’ Alex is brought into contact with the Brotherhood of Racing, a community of drivers looking to create safe racing conditions for amateurs.

programme.title: Car Crews with Supercar Blondie S1 - "Houston"

programme.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares
programme.desc: The venue is The Runaway Girl, a tapas bar-cum-nightclub in Sheffield city centre on the brink of collapse. The owner Justin Rowntree wont listen to reason, and his head chef and best friend Ritchie has had enough. Gordon is on hand to help the friends weather the storm with a credit crunch menu solution designed to take on the chains, but can Gordon save Justins failing business, and prevent his friendship with Ritchie ending up in tatters?

programme.title: The Cops
programme.desc: Its Halloween weekend and the Bodycam Squad are on the lookout for things that go bump in the night. Its not long before theyre called to investigate a skirmish at a nightclub, where a bouncer has had her hair pulled out by a female clubber in Stoke! Meanwhile the hunt is on for two suspected robbers whove given the police the slip on an industrial site. Theyre the main suspects in a spate of diesel fuel thefts costing local businesses 50,000. Late in the night, a van, which has been used for syphoning fuel is discovered in a remote part of Burton. When two men show up, the cops are certain theyve found the fuel thieves but they hadnt reckoned on the mens curious alibi. And, police dog Jax, leads a manhunt for some suspected van thieves. Using her powerful sense of smell, she follows their tracks to some bushes. What happens next makes it clear that a dog isnt always a mans best friend!

programme.title: The Cops
programme.desc: In the dead of night, the Bodycam Cops come across a man smashing his way into two high street stores with an axe. Inside one of the Stoke shops, astonishing CCTV footage captures the moment when the robber leads the cops on a merry dance, up and down the aisles! Another business has been targeted in the market town of Uttoxeter. This time, a hairdressers that has been hit twice with hundreds of pounds of hair products stolen. When Rich tracks down the main suspect, incredibly, he discovers the mans own house has just been burgled! And, Kerry, bravely deals with a shocking incident, where a man has been glassed in the back of the head while out for a drink in a pub. Fortunately, the suspects, a drunk woman and her boyfriend, are quickly apprehended by the pubs bouncers.

programme.title: The Cops
programme.desc: After complaints from neighbours in a residential street about anti-social behaviour related to drug activity, The Bodycam Squad prepare for a daylight raid on a house in Burton upon Trent. All kitted out with the latest body-worn video cameras and a door enforcer, they smash their way into the suspected drugs den. At the end of a long shift for undercover Bodycam Cops Graham and Greg, something extraordinary catches their attention - a man hanging by his trousers from some nine foot high railings. And, even more incredibly, hes sound asleep! Also, Alfie Bradley, a metal sculptor has created his own monument to the victims of knife crime. Using more than 100,000 weapons seized by the police or handed in during nationwide knife amnesties, hes crafted a majestic 27 foot figure called The Knife Angel.

programme.title: Gordon Ramsay: Shark Bait
programme.desc: The shark is one of the most extraordinary creatures on earth terrifying, beautiful and, for many, delicious. Fascinated by both how it is caught, and how it is consumed, Gordon explores the shark fishing industry, the history and culture behind shark fin soup, as well as the increasing demand for shark meat. But with shark numbers in decline he asks whether shark is a dish that needs to come off our menus for good.

programme.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares
programme.desc: Tim Gray is 21. Hes the Head Chef at Bonapartes in Silsden, West Yorkshire and he specializes in fine dining. He has ambitions to be a TV chef and one day hopes to open restaurants in London, Paris and New York. Unfortunately, as Gordon Ramsay discovers, Tim cant even cook an omelets and when he attempts to make dinner for his parents at home he manages to set the cooker alight. A true kitchen nightmare if ever you saw one. With no customers and a fridge full of fancy ingredients, Bonapartes is losing money fast. Owner Sue Ray has run out of ideas. Shes never owned a restaurant before and has been led astray by Tims enthusiasm for vanilla fumes and balsamic reductions. Ramsay soon establishes that what the people of Silsden really want to eat is Beef and Ale Pie and Treacle Tart and when he gets the menu back to basics the restaurant is chocker block. But can Tim cope with a full dining room when he hasnt ever cooked for more than 6 people at once? And will this simplistic style of cooking satisfy his hungry ambition?

programme.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares
programme.desc: Saturday night at the Glass House Restaurant in Ambleside is a nightmare. Orders in the kitchen are mixed up, foods not cooked properly and the customers are complaining. Not only is the chef in tears, but the owners on the brink as well. Neil Farrells owned the Lake District restaurant for 3 years and hes up to this eyes in debt. The business wont survive if the restaurants only busy on a Saturday night but with only 3,000 residents in the town, Neil has to attract the influx of visitors if hes going to fill the 90 seats every night. Gordon Ramsay rolls up his sleeves and gets involved in every detail of the business from scrubbing the grimy, slimy kitchen walls to teaching the waiters how to sell the food. He decides that the head chef is the weak link and sets about getting the kitchen in order. Ramsays not one to tread lightly - the waiter is told he has bad breath, the kitchen porters given a bollocking for dropping the cutlery, and owners invited outside for his criticisms of Ramsays Caesar salad. When Ramsay takes the head chef out of the equation, he discovers a great deal of talent in the young cooks.

programme.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares
programme.desc: The Walnut Tree Inn is in trouble theres no head chef, the customers have dwindled, and the owner has had to sell the family home to keep the business afloat. The Walnut Tree Inn in South Wales became a national institution under the ownership of Franco and Ann Tauscher, who successfully ran it for 37 years. But when fellow Italian Francesco bought the place 3 years ago he made the mistake of turning the warm and welcoming country inn into a cold and stark London-style restaurant. He achieved a Michelin star for the food but soon after that he lost his head chef. Donning his chefs whites and apron, Francesco tries to run the kitchen and be the host in the restaurant. Consequently he fails in both jobs. The customers arent returning and the foods going downhill. Ramsays first job is to recruit a new head chef so the owner can woo the customers and stop meddling in the kitchen. But hes also intent on making the dining room a cosier place and scotching rumours by bringing the previous owners back to lend Francesco their support for the Walnut Trees 40th Anniversary celebrations.

programme.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares
programme.desc: Nick and Richard are self-confessed restaurant virgins. Theyve both had successful careers in the brewery business so when they bought Moore Place last summer they thought their dream had come true. What they hadnt fathomed was just how difficult it would be to fill the 90-seater oak-paneled restaurant or find a chef who could cook decent food. Their first mistake was to paint the building purple. The wealthy Surrey residents hated it and refuse to enter the building. Weve got gold medals in fucking it up, admits Richard, and he cant think of a single evening when the restaurants run smoothly. Ramsay discovers some fundamental problems a chef who cant cook, a bunch of sultry waiters and a building that looks more like a funeral parlour than a restaurant. Can these brewery whizz-kids turn this former failing Berni Inn into a profitable business when they are continually faced with never-ending staff problems and a complete lack of know-how in the kitchen? If theyre going to succeed Ramsay has to teach them the rudiments of running a restaurant before they can even think of making a profit.

programme.title: Hotel Hell
programme.desc: Gordon Ramsay visits a Caribbean style resort hotel in Fort Pierce, Florida where the young inexperienced owner, Brian is making guests time at the hotel miserable with filthy rooms, late night concerts and shocking service. Brian has lost control, leaving the hotel staff to run wild. Gordon quickly realizes hes going to need something short of a miracle if hes going to stop this place from going under water.

programme.title: Hotel Hell
programme.desc: Gordon visits Island Park, Idaho to try and rescue the failing Anglers Lodge. Despite building the stunning lodge with his own hands, owner Dave Ebey has lost his passion and it has almost cost him his business. Gordon discovers a family tragedy has devastated the Ebeys and caused them to shy away from the hotel and the community. Gordon is desperate to help this couple at their breaking point but is he too late?

programme.title: Extreme Salvage Squad
programme.desc: Team Salvage has been called in to rescue a stranded vessel stuck in a mangrove jungle in North Queensland. It got blown in there by Cyclone Debbie. The only way they can get it out is to winch it out. But theres a problem. Theyve damaged the road on their way in to the mangroves and the boat has snapped in half.

programme.title: Extreme Salvage Squad
programme.desc: Team Salvage is trying to refloat a damaged vessel. The owners want to keep it and get it repaired. The squad successfully winches it out only to discover its leaking and is full of toxic fumes. They call in a favor from a local boatyard owner who agrees to slip and store the boat the next day. Their only chance to save the yacht is to tie it up to a jetty overnight. But theres a major storm front blowing in threatening to destroy the boat and the jetty.

programme.title: Extreme Salvage Squad
programme.desc: Team Salvage is towing a damaged yacht to a North Queensland boatyard. The vessel has a broken keel, no steering capacity and its taking on water. Theres a risk it will sink at sea. The tide has turned. Tensions are high. And theyre running out of time. And now they have to repay a favor to the boatyard owner. The salvage game is all about you scratch my back and Ill scratch yours. It will be their most dangerous salvage operation yet.

programme.title: Extreme Salvage Squad
programme.desc: Team Salvage is in the middle of a major rescue. But things are not looking good. Their winch tank retriever is bogged, their salvage Ute is bogged and the excavator they brought in to help them is also bogged. And thats just the start of their troubles. Theyve been commissioned to remove a giant floating pontoon that wont float. Reputations are on the line.

programme.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares
programme.desc: The venue for the first programme of the new series is La Lanterna in Letchworth, Hertfordshire. Twenty- eight-year-old owner and head chef Alex offers modern Italian cuisine, a taste of Little Italy in Englands first garden city, and the restaurant is run by his best mate maitre d Gavin, helped by his ex-air hostess girlfriend Emily. But Alex has no customers, cookers that dont work and an expensive menu thats about as authentically Italian as a spag bol. He re-mortgaged his house to buy the business, its losing 1,000 a week, he hasnt slept for months but still runs round town in a flash car (number plate: A1CHEF) thats worth more than the restaurant. Running out of money, inspiration and energy, Alex is on the verge of losing everything. Gordon rolls up his sleeves and sets to work on the encrusted kitchen cookers and hapless front-of-house staff. Can a strict diet of brutal honesty, radical food surgery and undiluted energy turn things round, or is it only a matter of time before the lights go out at La Lanterna for good?

programme.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares
programme.desc: The venue for tonights second programme is D-Place in Chelmsford, Essex run by Mexican born Israel and his English partner Tara. Theyve sunk 150,000 of their own money into their trendy caf bar which offers a vast selection of fusion cuisine. In charge is Executive Chef Philippe, producing everything from all-day breakfasts to hoi sin noodles with an astounding lack of flair; the plastic food is dire and boomerangs back from the dining room as soon as its cooked. Restaurant manager, spunky Essex boy Dave, loathes his chef, and their mutual hatred spills over into permanent running battles. Faced with dysfunctional staff and a disastrous menu, Gordon is about to face the longest week of his professional life. Can he quell the panic, banish the deep fat fryer and bring D-Place back from the dead, or will it disappear forever?

programme.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares
programme.desc: The venue for tonights third programme is Momma Cherris Soul Food Shack, an intimate forty- seater a stones throw from Brightons sea front. Big soul momma, owner CHARITA JONES, produces a menu of irresistibly unique classics from the Deep South. The foods hard to fault but the punters are nowhere to be seen, Head Chef Brian and a rag-tag collection of part-timers are taking the mickey - and despite working a seven-day week Charitas got an empty restaurant and a 65,000 debt. If ever there was a case of too many cooks, this is it. Charitas a natural, but shes never made a profit on the restaurant and is now facing financial disaster. Can Gordon successfully shut her out of the kitchen, get the chef back on the boil and put the soul back into the business, or will the shack shut up shop for good?

programme.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares
programme.desc: The venue for tonights fourth programme is La Riviera, a fine dining restaurant in Inverness. Owned by multi-millionaire Barry Larson and costing 8000 a week to run, the place boasts top French chef Loic Lefebvre and an impeccably-trained kitchen staff with Michelin star studded backgrounds. Loic is on a mission, to bring sophisticated French cooking to the home of haggis, tatties and deep-fried Mars bars. But though hes hungry for success, hes arrogant and the foods pretentious. The locals arent biting and the restaurants empty most nights. Theres a sharp smell of dj vu in the air for Gordon whose own venture in Scotland - Amaryllis - had to close. This week its personal as Ramsay tries to save La Riviera from the same fate. Can Gordon tone down their act, demystify the menu and, most importantly, get the punters in?

programme.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares
programme.desc: The venue for tonights program is Clubway 41, despite being voted Blackpool Tourist Board Restaurant of the year, the place is dire straits. It is the prime example of HOW NOT TO RUN A RESTAURANT. Owner DAVE is the flakey self-appointed head chef, who hasnt been in a kitchen for 30 years and cant cook. His partner DAWN invents bizarre dishes for the menu, ranging from tomato and cointreau soup to pork with brie, nectarine and whiskey sauce. Gordon faces a hellish week as Clubway 41 is breaking every rule in book. Can he bring Dave, Dawn and their food back down to earth?

programme.title: Hotel Hell
programme.desc: Gordon Ramsay visits Meson de Mesilla, a luxury Tuscan-style hotel in Las Cruces, New Mexico. Owner and child-star, Cali Szczawinski, purchased the hotel to perform Cher songs every night to a captive audience. Too busy trying to hit the high notes on stage (the hotel has three of them), Cali has failed to notice that shes falling flat when it comes to what her hotel guests need. The bedrooms are empty, the hotels restaurant is failing, and Gordon witnesses a shocking exit that no one saw coming. Can Gordon turn back time? Or is this boutique hotel, and its singing owner, beyond his help?

programme.title: Hotel Hell
programme.desc: Gordon Ramsay checks in to The Monticello Hotel in Longview, Washington, owned by Phillip Lovingfoss: a wealthy individual with a fleet of classic cars, an array of diamond rings and a drinking problem so serious that it is threatening to destroy his hotel, and his life. Gordon discovers the extent of Phillips problem when he sees shocking news about the owner splashed all over the front page of the newspaper. Can Gordon save fifty staff jobs and keep the doors to this ninety year old hotel (a place once described as the jewel of Longview) open, or is he too late?

programme.title: Hotel Hell
programme.desc: Gordon visits Applegate, Oregon, to try to rescue the failing Applegate River Lodge. Despite being over a million dollars in debt, the Applegates owner, Richard Davis, is more interested in smoking cannabis in his Butt Hut than he is in fixing the problems of this family-built inn. Richards sons Duke and Dusty are too busy fighting each other to notice the ever-increasing debt, leaving their mother, Joanna with the entire burden of the inns finances resting on her shoulders. Can Gordon turn this family around before the hotel and the family legacy are destroyed? And how will he react to a room full of dancing mushrooms and a dog that swims through the air?

programme.title: Hotel Hell
programme.desc: Gordon visits Starkville, Mississippi to try to rescue the failing Hotel Chester. Despite having over 40 years experience in the hotel business, owner David Mollendor is at a loss on how to make his dream of owning his own hotel work. Sukie, his wife, is struggling as the hotel restaurants chef, tackling the role without any culinary experience, and sinking fast. Gordon discovers a family tragedy which explains why this couple have become trapped in their hotel and are drowning in debt. Gordon is desperate to help the two owners escape from their suffering, but is he too late to stop the hotels doors closing for good?

programme.title: Hotel Hell
programme.desc: Gordon visits West Dover in Vermont, to try to save a dog-friendly hotel thats desperately in need of help. Sandy MacDougall, the owner, runs the hotel like a hostel with unpaid staff staying in the rooms instead of paying guests. Can Gordon get the Four Seasons back on track before Sandy loses everything? Or is the kindest thing simply to put this dog-friendly hotel to sleep?

programme.title: Hotel Hell
programme.desc: Gordon Ramsay checks in to Murphys Historic Hotel near Sacramento in northern California, where party-boy owners Brian, Kevin and Joel are too busy drinking, partying and lap-dancing in the rowdy bar, to look after their historic hotel. The national landmark, which has been host to an array of famous names including Mark Twain, President Ulysses S. Grant and J.P. Morgan, has no hotel manager, so guests have a miserable time in the noisy, neglected, afterthought of a hotel. Gordon quickly realizes hes going to need something approaching a miracle if hes going to have a chance of saving this chaotic place.

programme.title: Hotel Hell
programme.desc: Gordon checks in to Connecticuts oldest inn, the Curtis House. This historic inn has been run by the Hardisty family for generations, but the business has started to fall apart and the family legacy is on the brink of being lost. The inn is currently run by brother and sister, T.J and Chris, but they no longer speak to each other and the staff and guests are stuck in the middle. Can Gordon save the historic inn and rescue a family at breaking point? And what will Gordon make of Betty, the inns resident ghost who he has to share a bedroom with?

programme.title: Rage
programme.desc: When soft spoken and timid Temisan’s world turns upside down and her former loving husband starts to abuse her physically and verbally. She starts to find a seething rage building up inside her.

programme.title: The Couple
programme.desc: A happily married couple face some challenges when the husband loses his job and a jealous friend makes it her mission to destroy their lives.

programme.title: The Awakening
programme.desc: Cynthia is a single mother, haunted by bad dreams which she believes prevents her from finding love. She seeks help from a prophetess on the advise of her friends but soon finds out that she has been deceived.

programme.title: We Tha Boyz
programme.desc: Four jolly teenagers decide to help their friend, Tokunbo, in his plans to get the love of Chioma, however, a rival gang is also vying for her attention. Tokunbo’s parents go out of town and they decide to throw the ultimate house party to impress her. As simple as the plan seems, in reality however, they get in several problems in order to pull it off and end up almost ruining the house.

programme.title: Blast From The Past
programme.desc: A long-lost father reappears as a boyfriend. Confused, heartbroken, and desperate for answers, Emily must confront the mystery surrounding her father’s disappearance and his unexpected re-emergence.

programme.title: Private Place
programme.desc: Two couples, faced with trouble in their respective marriages, take drastic action to get back on track.

programme.title: Dying Of Love
programme.desc: When his marriage proposal is rejected due to his current finanacial position, Tunde struggles to bounce back and trust his partner, leaving the door open for other temptation to get in.

programme.title: The Church Boy
programme.desc: Ify and Andy's near-perfect relationship is threatened by the beautiful Leah. How far will this relationship stand the test of time?

programme.title: Love On A Budget
programme.desc: A chance encounter leads Lotanna and Nancy to each other, but their love is tested when real life issues and financial pressure gets in the middle of their romance.

programme.title: AMC Music Moments - Playlist 518
programme.desc: AMC presents music from the latest African artists.

programme.title: Shades Of Lies
programme.desc: Teni's ambitions get the best of her when she follows bad advices at work after her boss, Chief Maxwell, is involved in an accident. When Chief Maxwell's family suspect foul play, the police get involved and it becomes increasingly clear that there is more to Chief Maxwell's death than meets the eye.

programme.title: Reform
programme.desc: Two detectives are forced to team up with a sinister criminal to save the daughter of an important man. Can they put their differences aside for the mission?

programme.title: Love Stake

programme.title: Self-Reliance - How It Can Help You Get Farther Ahead
programme.desc: In this episode of "The Rundown with Ramon," media consultant Maha Abouelenein discusses her new book, "Seven Rules of Self-Reliance." In this interview with Ramon Ray, publisher of ZoneofGenius.com, Abouelenein shares insights from her career working with tech giants and high-profile individuals, offering practical advice for personal and professional growth. She emphasizes the importance of creating value, managing one's reputation, and adopting a long-term mindset. Abouelenein also shares personal experiences that shaped her approach to life and work, providing listeners with actionable strategies for success in today's fast-paced world.

programme.title: Black Owned Stock Exchange is Expanding Public Market Access
programme.desc: Joe Cecala, co-founder of The Dream Exchange, is on a mission to create America's first minority-owned stock exchange. In an interview with small business expert Ramon Ray, Cecala outlined his vision for revolutionizing capital formation for small and underserved businesses. The Dream Exchange aims to fill a crucial gap in the market by providing public market access to companies seeking $5-100 million in funding, a range often overlooked by traditional financial institutions. The exchange's focus on underserved markets, including minority-owned businesses and companies in overlooked regions, sets it apart from existing exchanges. Cecala emphasized the broader implications of this venture, seeing it as a catalyst for innovation, job creation, and economic growth across diverse communities. While still navigating the complex regulatory process, The Dream Exchange is poised to potentially reshape the landscape of public markets, offering new opportunities for both entrepreneurs and investors. Cecala's parting message encapsulates the exchange's ethos: "Don't quit on your dreams."

programme.title: Stanley on the Go
programme.desc: Stanley Siegel, the late broadcaster, known to millions for his groundbreaking and often controversial interviews on WABC-and with Stanley On The Go he single-handedly redefines the travel show. Indeed, he redefines the notion of adventure: you don't have to be a young Olympian to have a zest for life. Experience shouldn't - and doesn't - end at 60. Stanley shows that there's more to retirement than bingo and shuffleboard on the Lido deck. He's an inspiration. Stanley takes us headlong around the globe: whether he's on a camel in Giza, the deck of a Navy aircraft carrier off San Diego, straddling a speeding motorbike through the streets of Moscow, or balancing on top of the Sydney Harbor Bridge, each episode is a tour de force with a force of nature. Stanley is irrepressible, his commentary is not only informative and enlightening, but is also often surprising and frequently irreverent. He shows us the iconic sights-the Grand Tour-but also uncovers the unexpected.

programme.title: Anita Oday - DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Bill Evans, Chuck Israels & Larry Bunker - Bill Evans' European Tour: Live in '64, '65 & '70
programme.desc: Bill Evans: Live in '64, '65 & '70 features five separate performances by one of the most revered pianists in music history. This collection covers an 11-year span, highlighting Evans’ ever-deepening artistry as he performs with four different all-star rhythm sections, including the stunning duo of bassist Niels-Henning Ørsted Pedersen and drummer Alan Dawson. This recording includes Evans’ renditions of the rarely performed “Sareen Jurer,” “Blue Serge”, and “Twelve Tone Tune Two.” Among the many surprises in this collection is a live performance of “My Melancholy Baby” with saxophonist Lee Konitz.

programme.title: Gil Evans & Ornette Coleman - Gil Evans, Ornette Coleman - Schloss Ansbach
programme.desc: This program presents two concerts from Schloss Ansbach in 1978. The first concert features Gil Evans and his orchestra, consisting of Gil Evans on piano, Steve Lacy on soprano saxophone, Arthur Blythe on alto saxophone, Pit Levin on synthesizers, Earl McIntyre on trombone, Lewis Soloff on trumpet, Geoffrey Berlin on bass and Sue Evans on percussion instruments. The second concert features saxophonist Ornette Coleman at the peak of his musically expressive powers. Coleman is joined by Bern Nix on guitar, Charles Ellerbee on guitar, Albert Arnold on bass, and Shannon Jackson on drums and percussion.

programme.title: Raul Midón - Sunshine (I Can Fly)
programme.desc: Raul Midón appeared at 2017’s Sing Jazz Festival in Singapore with double bassist Romeir Mendez and drummer Billy Williams. Blind since birth, Raul Midón is a singer, guitarist, and songwriter from New Mexico. With a vocal range as dynamic as his guitar playing and a remarkable talent for trumpet mimicry, Midón’s performances transcend musical boundaries, effortlessly blending rock, jazz, folk, and Latin pop into his unique sound. He has worked with numerous legends, including Bill Withers, Herbie Hancock, Sting, and Dianne Reeves, and his album ‘Bad Ass and Blind’ was nominated for a Grammy Award for Best Jazz Vocal Album in 2018. No wonder the Sing Jazz audience were ecstatic!

programme.title: Jimmy Witherspoon & Rozaa Wortham - Jimmy Witherspoon Quartet & Rozaa Wortham 1985
programme.desc: Since 1977, Estival is a summer jazz festival in Switzerland, Lugano. Estival offers a thrilling and particularly surprising line-up that explores the rich world of contemporary music whilst promoting the understanding of different cultures, tolerance, and co-existence. Jimmy Witherspoon and Rozaa Wortham, two incredible brilliant jazz musicians. Rozaa Wortham starts off the show with the Jimmy Witherspoon Quartet. Swinging and full of energy she performs ‘It Don’t Mean A Thing’. Jimmy Witherspoon, known for the song “Ain’t Nobody’s Business” ends the show with some astounding lean-back blues.

programme.title: Kenny Barron - Kenny Barron, Song for Abdullah
programme.desc: Pianist Kenny Barron’s June 27, 2019 appearance at the Alfa Jazz Festival in Ukraine’s Lviv was a celebration of sublime jazz virtuosity. The revered elder statesmen of jazz piano brought his regular working trio of Kiyoshi Kitagawa (bass) and Jonathan Blake (drums), augmented by stellar jazzman Marcus Strickland (tenor saxophone) and young lion Riley Mulherkar (trumpet). Their seamless blend of classic bebop and modern explorations spoke of a deep, emotive connection to each note, captivating the Ukrainian audience with lyrical improvisations during this unforgettable concert.

programme.title: Manu Katché, Alfio Origlio, Walter Ricci & Jérôme Regard - Katché & Origlio Quartet feat. Walter Ricci
programme.desc: Four exceptional musicians team up to perform classic pop and soul songs made famous by the likes of Gregory Porter, Stevie Wonder, U2, Seal, and many more. Pianist Alfio Origlio signed up to do the arrangements. Walter Ricci, an accomplished jazz vocalist from Naples, eases us into his musical universe with his stunning sensitivity. He is accompanied by an exceptional rhythm section composed of Manu Katché on drums, Jérôme Regard on bass, and Alfio Origlio on piano. This concert was recorded at Festival Jazz au Sommet 2020 in France.

programme.title: Dizzy Gillespie - DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Bobby McFerrin - Bobby McFerrin - Estival Jazz Lugano
programme.desc: Estival Jazz Lugano is an annual, open-air music festival that takes place over five days in the picturesque city of Lugano, Switzerland. Since 1979, this musical Mecca has been a must-attend event for all jazz and world music fans worldwide. In 1985, American vocal virtuoso Bobby McFerrin took the stage solo at Estival Jazz Lugano. The one-man musical force stunned the audience with his unique vocal percussion as he delved into the crowd for this quirky and charming act.

programme.title: Charles Lloyd, Keith Jarrett, Cecil McBee & Jack DeJohnette - Charles Lloyd Quartet live in Brussels
programme.desc: Since 1960, the legendary saxophonist Charles Lloyd has lent his adventurous, lyrical sound to collaborations with likes of Cannonball Adderley, Keith Jarrett and The Beach Boys. His early and highly successful experiments blending jazz and rock music charted a path that led to the electric fusion of Miles Davis and The Headhunters, while his exploration of spirituality and transcendental meditation added a new depth to his sound. Lloyd moves from hard swing to subtle ballads, blending gorgeous textures and Eastern influences. This 1966 recording features Lloyd’s quartet, accompanied by Keith Jarrett (piano), Cecil McBee (double bass) and Jack DeJohnette (drums), playing some of Lloyd’s own compositions.

programme.desc: Since 1960, the legendary saxophonist Charles Lloyd has lent his adventurous, lyrical sound to collaborations with likes of Cannonball Adderley, Keith Jarrett and The Beach Boys. His early and highly successful experiments blending jazz and rock music charted a path that led to the electric fusion of Miles Davis and The Headhunters, while his exploration of spirituality and transcendental meditation added a new depth to his sound. Lloyd moves from hard swing to subtle ballads, blending gorgeous textures and Eastern influences. This 1966 recording features Lloyd’s quartet, accompanied by Keith Jarrett (piano), Cecil McBee (double bass) and Jack DeJohnette (drums), playing some of Lloyd’s own compositions.

programme.title: Evanescence - Synthesis Live
programme.desc: In 2003, Evanescence released Fallen, one of the most decade-defining albums (and one of the most successful debut albums of all time) and have gone on to became one of the most well-loved & respected bands of their generation. In the 15 years since their debut, Evanescence founder and lead-singer, Amy Lee, toured the world, has scored motion picture films and even took a 3 year break to start a family. In late 2017, Evanescence re-emerged from their hiatus with Synthesis—a reimagining of their best-known songs with orchestra & electronics and an accompanying sold-out and highly-acclaimed world tour. On November 3, 2017 Evanescence performed “Synthesis Live” in front of a sold out crowd at the Grand Theater at Foxwoods Casino in CT.

programme.title: Slipknot - Day of the Gusano
programme.desc: After more than a decade of patiently waiting, the Mexican Maggots finally welcome the most anticipated visit of Slipknot and Knotfest to Mexico. On December 8th, 2015, Knotfest took over Mexico City for the experience of a lifetime. The most passionate, powerful, dedicated and loud Maggots on Earth attended in hordes to witness in action their most inspirational figures: the 9 members of Slipknot. The band did not disappoint. This show will leave you speechless and craving more. The intensity of Slipknot and the love they have for their fans is palpable. The wait was well worth it.

programme.title: Ozzy Osbourne - God Bless Ozzy Osbourne
programme.desc: Ozzy Osbourne is one of the most iconic figures in rock and one of the founding fathers of heavy metal. "God Bless Ozzy Osbourne" tells for the first time the story of his career from the founding of Black Sabbath through to solo stardom and his wider fame beyond. These were the wild days of his prodigious drug and alcohol intake, of biting the head from a dove at a record company meeting and biting into a bat on stage but also of the tragic death of Randy Rhoads and the reality TV show The Osbournes. The film follows Ozzy's torturous and emotionally fraught journey from excess to sobriety, which Ozzy regards as his greatest accomplishment. Featuring never before seen footage, new interviews with Ozzy himself, his family, his bandmates, and those who both inspired him and were inspired by him, this is the first film to take viewers inside the mind and psyche of this legendary figure.

programme.title: Queens of the Stone Age - Zénith Paris 2013
programme.desc: Get your fill of riff-oriented heavy rock with this dark and moody performance by Queens of the Stone Age. Best enjoyed with the volume turned up high!

programme.title: Alabama Shakes - Austin City Limits
programme.desc: Mixing classic R&B vocals with a soulful blues-rock base, Alabama Shakes have taken garage rock and turned it on its head. Alabama Shakes takes the Austin City Limits stage for the second time in support of their newest album Sound & Color.

programme.title: Paul McCartney - The Space Within US
programme.desc: Paul McCartney presents this special performance of the US Tour, made in the United States, 11 weeks and 34 shows, playing great compositions of his solo career along with some Wings and Beatles songs.

programme.title: Eric Clapton & Steve Winwood - Eric Clapton & Steve Winwood - Live from MSG
programme.desc: History rocked and rock made history during a sold-out three-gig stand at Madison Square Garden in late February 2008 when icons Eric Clapton and Steve Winwood performed a concert together for the first time since their all-too-brief days in the legendary Blind Faith in 1969. Whether they will ever team again is unknown. But with Eric Clapton and Steve Winwood Live From Madison Square Garden fans everywhere are able to experience the sound and the glory of a performance on that famous stage by two of rock's greatest artists.

programme.title: AC/DC - Circus Krone
programme.desc: Filmed at the world famous Circus Krone in Munich, this AC/DC concert from June 17, 2003 features standout performances of "Rock N Roll Damnation" and "What's Next To The Moon" and more.

programme.title: Kiss - Live in Nürburgring
programme.desc: Kiss is one of the legendary groups in Hard Rock history. They have millions of fans around the world and over 100 million records sold. KISS confirms why they have been the best on the scene for nearly four decades, in a performance that made history, impressing an audience of more than 85,000 people, in a show of more than 2 hours and packed with hits, held at the Nurburgring, Germany in 2010.

programme.title: Guns N' Roses - Live From The O2 Arena London
programme.desc: Watch this mega-production of Guns N’ Roses performing live at the O2 Arena to its fans singing and vibrating to each song. Includes; Paradise City, Sweet Child O’ Mine, November Rain and many more.

programme.title: Lady Gaga - Live in London 2013
programme.desc: Lady Gaga's performance at the iTunes Festival in London on September 1, 2013 marks the superstar's first full concert since the The Born This Way Ball. It is an eight song set containing the world premiere of seven tracks from her fourth album, ARTPOP: "Aura"; "MANiCURE"; "Artpop"; "Jewels N' Drugs" ft. T.I., Too $hort and Twista; "Sexxx Dreams", "Swine"; and "I Wanna Be With You", a song that transformed into "Dope" for ARTPOP. During the concert, captured stunningly in HD, Gaga says that she's "a bit like Dorothy right now." The stage is her Kansas, the crowd is her family, and their reunion is pure magic. Lady Gaga, her dancers, and her band traverse through visual and musical themes of love, sex, violence, beauty, danger, empowerment, hustle, lust, and above all ART. Throughout, Gaga lays her heart bare for the audience and the cameras with every note sung and every word spoken.

programme.title: Evanescence - Synthesis Live
programme.desc: In 2003, Evanescence released Fallen, one of the most decade-defining albums (and one of the most successful debut albums of all time) and have gone on to became one of the most well-loved & respected bands of their generation. In the 15 years since their debut, Evanescence founder and lead-singer, Amy Lee, toured the world, has scored motion picture films and even took a 3 year break to start a family. programme.title: Moonlight in Vermont
programme.desc: When Fiona gets dumped she heads for a week in Vermont at her Dad's country Inn. There she runs into her ex with his new girlfriend. She strikes a deal with the Inn's chef, Derek, to be her "boyfriend" for the week.

programme.title: Love Takes Flight
programme.desc: In the Hallmark Hall of Fame Presentation, a young girl befriends a lonely widower as a part of her Mission: Find a Friend, uniting their families in a healing twist of fate. Stars Nikki DeLoach and Jeff Hephner.

programme.title: Dating the Delaneys
programme.desc: Three generations of Delaney women explore the highs and lows of modern-day dating, learning that love and romance can be found at any age…and sometimes where you least expect it. Stars Rachel Boston and Paul Campbell.

programme.title: Guiding Emily
programme.desc: Emily's life changes after losing her eyesight, while a guide dog struggles with training. Through a series of missed encounters both overcome their obstacles and find each other. Stars Sarah Drew, Antonio Cupo, Eric McCormack.

programme.title: A Ring by Spring
programme.desc: A fiercely independent single woman is forced to consider marrying her not-so-perfect boyfriend when a gypsy fortuneteller convinces her she must be engaged by the spring or risk a lifetime alone.

programme.title: Love Blossoms
programme.desc: Perfumer Violet is desperate to formulate her late father's unfinished signature scent. Under great pressure to finish by Valentine's Day, Violet hires an inexperienced botanist with an uncanny ability to identify scents.

programme.title: Stranded in Paradise
programme.desc: When a HR exec loses her job, she travels to Puerto Rico for a business conference. But as the trip becomes a disaster and a hurricane shuts down the whole island, she meets a handsome traveler who gives her a new perspective.

programme.title: The Beach House
programme.desc: When Cara finds her life spinning out of control, she returns to the scenic Lowcountry to visit her mother. Before long, the rhythms of the island open her heart in wonderful ways as she repairs the family beach house.

programme.title: The Sweeter Side of Life
programme.desc: Pampered Manhattan housewife Desiree Harper has it all. That is until her husband unexpectedly dumps her. Faced with an airtight prenup, Desiree reluctantly lands a job making cupcakes at her father's struggling bakery.

programme.title: Big Sky River
programme.desc: Tara needs to go back to Parable, Montana, the place that made her the happiest, in order to move forward after a messy divorce. Her handsome neighbor presents an unexpected twist. Starring Emmanuelle Vaugier, Kavan Smith.

programme.title: The Magic of Ordinary Days
programme.desc: Pregnant out of wedlock, an educated young woman is pressured by her father into an arranged marriage with a lonely farmer in this drama set during WWII. Stars Keri Russell and Skeet Ulrich.

programme.title: One Summer
programme.desc: Jack takes his son and daughter to his late wife's beachside hometown hoping to heal and become closer. The summer brings visions of the past that could forge a new path forward. Stars Sam Page, Sarah Drew and Amanda Schull.

programme.title: Pearl in Paradise
programme.desc: Alex, a photographer for a travel magazine, and Colin, a best-selling author, team up to find an elusive Fijian pearl.

programme.title: Mystery 101: Pilot
programme.desc: When a college student is found dead, English professor Amy uses her crime fiction expertise to unravel the case faster than detective Travis, who ends up working with Amy to catch the killer. Stars Jill Wagner, Kristoffer Polaha.

programme.title: A Summer Romance
programme.desc: Samantha's Montana ranch is her family's legacy, so when a developer shows up to buy it, Sam isn't interested. But as he tries to win her trust and her ranch, Sam finds he might also be winning her heart. Erin Krakow, Ryan Paevey.

programme.title: The Nine Lives of Christmas
programme.desc: Zachary Stone, a handsome bachelor with distaste for responsibility, sees his life change before his eyes when he decides to adopt a stray cat.

programme.title: Valentine in the Vineyard
programme.desc: Back for the third installment, Frankie and Nate manage life on the vineyard and plan a wedding in secret! Stars Rachael Leigh Cook and Brendan Penny.

programme.title: Love to the Rescue
programme.desc: Two single parents come head to head when their kids want to adopt the same dog. Agreeing to co-foster, free-spirited Kate and type-A Eric must work together to find the dog's forever home. Starring Nikki DeLoach and Michael Rady.

programme.title: Color My World with Love
programme.desc: Emma's daughter Kendall becomes engaged, but Emma is concerned as Kendall and her fiancé have Down Syndrome and Emma worries she's not ready to take this step. Stars Lily D. Moore, Erica Durance, Benjamin Ayres, David DeSanctis.

programme.title: Sweet Carolina
programme.desc: Marketing executive, Josie, returns home when she becomes the unexpected guardian of her niece and nephew. While there, she reconnects with Cooper, her high school boyfriend. Stars Lacey Chabert, Tyler Hynes.

programme.title: Love of the Irish
programme.desc: Tired of her bad luck, Fiona takes her mom on a trip to Ireland to turn things around where she meets a charming single dad who helps her make her own luck. Stars Shenae Grimes-Beech, Stephen Hagan, Moira Kelly.

programme.title: Hearts in the Game
programme.desc: A NYC publicist helps an MLB pitcher find his way back to the game and to her heart. Starring Erin Cahill and Marco Grazzini.

programme.title: The Perfect Setting
programme.desc: An aspiring jewelry designer returns to Belgium to visit her grandfather and hopefully win the Valentines Day Diamond Contest. Stars Laci J. Mailey, David Elsendoorn.

programme.title: Love, Romance & Chocolate
programme.desc: Emma and chocolatier Luc compete for Belgium's Royal Chocolatier. The beauty and romance of Bruges inspire unique chocolate combinations, but will their entry win without them losing their hearts? Stars Lacey Chabert, Will Kemp.

programme.title: Romance at Hope Ranch
programme.desc: Hope Morgan sets out to begin a new chapter of her life—fulfilling her childhood dream of running a ranch in the picturesque town of Ruidoso, New Mexico and reviving the beloved Giddy Up Gala. Stars Alison Sweeney, Gabriel Hogan.

programme.title: One Perfect Wedding
programme.desc: With her book tour in two weeks and his expanding business plans, Cara and Ben put their long engagement behind them and book the chalet for a small wedding with friends and family. Starring Taylor Cole and Jack Turner.

programme.title: Paris, Wine & Romance
programme.desc: Isabella travels to Paris to compete in a major wine competition. While there she meets, Jacque, a competitor who shows her the city of love and teaches her about how wine is more than just a business. Jen Lilley, Dan Jeannotte.

programme.title: A Little Daytime Drama
programme.desc: In order to save her daytime soap drama from cancellation, head writer Maggie must convince Darin, fan favorite actor and her real-life ex-boyfriend, to return to the show. Stars Jen Lilley, Ryan Paevey, Linda Dano.

programme.title: The Perfect Catch
programme.desc: When her high school boyfriend, a superstar baseball player, returns to town, a single-parent finds the inspiration to reinvent her struggling diner... and revisits the past to find something even better for the future.

programme.title: Home Turf
programme.desc: Cassidy is the president of a small college whose life is thrown for a loop when freshmen on the football team move into her home. Can Logan, the handsome coach, help smooth things over? Stars Nikki DeLoach, Warren Christie.

programme.title: Texas Two-Step
programme.desc: Olivia returns to Texas to help her aunt with her country music bar that's fallen on hard times and reconnects with Luke, her childhood sweetheart turned cowboy, and her passion for dancing. Stars Heather Hemmens, Brendan Penny.

programme.title: Hearts of Winter
programme.desc: An interior designer brings new life to the house of a widower and his daughter and finds love in the process. Stars Jill Wagner, Victor Webster, Rukiya Bernard.

programme.title: Love on the Danube: Love Song
programme.desc: Fellow cruise passengers, Sarah and Jack, play matchmaker with their music loving widowed parents, as they cruise down the Danube visiting European cities. Stars Nazneen Contractor, Wes Brown, Kathryn Drysdale, Catherine Disher.

programme.title: All's Fair in Love & Mahjong
programme.desc: A school nurse finds unexpected hope through teaching Mahjong, the centuries‑old Chinese game, which helps her build community and open her heart again. Stars Fiona Gubelmann, Paul Campbell, Yan-Kay Crystal Lowe.

programme.title: Haunted Wedding
programme.desc: Jana and Brian's plan to wed is in jeopardy when Angelique, a ghost in an 18th century wedding dress, vows to stop it. The couple must work together to save their wedding from disaster. Stars Janel Parrish, Dominic Sherwood.

programme.title: Fourth Down and Love
programme.desc: Sparks are reignited when a single mother and a pro football player coincidentally meet again on her daughter's flag football field after his career is interrupted by a sports injury. Stars Pascale Hutton, Ryan Paevey.

programme.title: Taking the Reins
programme.desc: A writer goes back to the family ranch to write an article about her passion for horses and discovers what ended her marriage and why she stopped riding horses. Stars Nikki DeLoach, Scott Porter.

programme.title: The Heiress and the Handyman
programme.desc: After losing her fortune, an heiress moves to a rural farm where she mistakes her handsome neighbor for the handyman. To live up to her family's legacy, he helps her compete at the county fair. Stars Jodie Sweetin, Corey Sevier.

programme.title: Autumn at Apple Hill
programme.desc: Elise is trying to keep her family inn afloat when the CFO of a major hotel chain checks in as a guest. Is he there to enjoy the fall season or try to take over her beloved inn? Stars Erin Cahill, Wes Brown.

programme.title: Sweet Autumn
programme.desc: Aunt Dee splits her candy shop between her niece, Maggie, and maple farmer, Dex. Following letters Dee left, the two uncover the reason for her decision, during the Sweet Autumn festival. Stars Nikki DeLoach & Andrew Walker.

programme.title: The Nine Lives of Christmas
programme.desc: Zachary Stone, a handsome bachelor with distaste for responsibility, sees his life change before his eyes when he decides to adopt a stray cat.

programme.title: The Nine Kittens of Christmas
programme.desc: Cat lovers Zachary and Marilee are thrown back together at Christmas when they're tasked with finding homes for a litter of adorable kittens. Stars Brandon Routh, Kimberley Sustad, Gregory Harrison.

programme.title: Debbie Macomber's Dashing Through the Snow
programme.desc: After a snafu at the airport, Ashley is forced to rent a car in order to make it home to Seattle by Christmas. She ends up sharing the last rental car on the lot with Dash, a handsome stranger, also on his way to Seattle.

programme.title: A Suite Holiday Romance
programme.desc: Sabrina, an aspiring writer rejoices when hired to ghostwrite for a famous art dealer at an iconic hotel during Christmas. She learns to take risks and falls in love with a British visitor. Jessy Schram, Dominic Sherwood.

programme.title: Believe in Christmas
programme.desc: With no other plans for Christmas, best friends BEA and EMILIA travel to Christmasland, a magical place filled with hope, holiday miracles, and romance. But could this all be too good to be true? Stars Meghan Ory, John Reardon.

programme.title: Never Kiss a Man in a Christmas Sweater
programme.desc: Single mom Maggie is facing Christmas alone until Lucas crashes into her life and becomes an unexpected houseguest. Together they overcome Christmas while finding comfort in their growing bond. Stars Ashley Williams, Niall Matter.

programme.title: 'Tis the Season to be Merry
programme.desc: Looking for a fresh angle to her book on relationships, Merry heads to snow covered Vermont. She finds a new perspective and Christmas cheer with charismatic aid worker Adam. Starring Rachael Leigh Cook and Travis Van Winkle.

programme.title: Rescuing Christmas
programme.desc: Erin is granted 3 Christmas wishes – with her final wish being that Christmas would just disappear. And to her bewilderment, it does! Can potential suitor Sam help her bring back Christmas? Stars Rachael Leigh Cook, Sam Page.

programme.title: 'Twas the Date Before Christmas
programme.desc: Feeling the pressure to bring someone home for Christmas, Jessie convinces Bryan to join her family for a day filled with holiday events, only the family doesn't know it's their first date. Stars Robert Buckley, Amy Groening.

programme.title: Catch Me If You Claus
programme.desc: Avery Quinn's shot at anchoring news clashes with a Santa-suited intruder, Chris, who insists he's Santa's son on a first Christmas mission. They unravel a career-making story together. Starring Italia Ricci and Luke MacFarlane.

programme.title: Haul Out the Holly: Lit Up
programme.desc: Emily and Jared lead the Evergreen Lane HOA toward another successful Christmas season. Lacey Chabert, Wes Brown.

programme.title: Oy to the World!
programme.desc: Nikki, a perfectionist, must reconnect with her childhood rival, Jake, an aspiring musician, as the duo unites choirs for a performance honoring Christmas and Hanukkah. Starring Brooke D'Orsay, and Jake Epstein.

programme.title: Debbie Macomber's Joyful Mrs. Miracle
programme.desc: Mrs. Miracle uses Christmas magic to reunite three siblings who must decide who will inherit the family's real estate empire following their grandmother's passing. Stars Rachel Boston, Pascal Lamothe-Kipnes, and Tanner Novlan.

programme.title: A Christmas Angel Match
programme.desc: Monica, a Christmas angel, works to set couples up at the most wonderful time of year. That is, until Michael is assigned to the same couple and their differing tactics cause chaos. Starring Meghan Ory and Benjamin Ayres.

programme.title: A Christmas Melody
programme.desc: An inspiring Christmas story about a single mother, Kari, moving back to her hometown with her young daughter, Emily. When the little girl has a hard time adjusting, she seeks out the help of her music teacher, Danny.

programme.title: Christmas at the Plaza
programme.desc: When historian Jessica is hired to create The Plaza's Christmas display, she finds more than facts while teaming up with handsome decorator Nick to bring the display to life. Starring Elizabeth Henstridge and Ryan Paevey.

programme.title: A Danish Christmas
programme.desc: Marie helps her family's Copenhagen inn at Christmas when Ryan arrives, and she mistakes him for a travel writer. She curates a tour in search of hygge and the two find a connection as well. Stars Emilie Ullerup, Corey Sevier.

programme.title: A December Bride
programme.desc: Layla is dreading the Christmastime wedding of her cousin who's marrying Layla's ex-fiance. She begrudgingly accepts Seth's offer to be her date as she's out of options.

programme.title: A Grand Ole Opry Christmas (Extended Cut)
programme.desc: Grand Ole Opry magic takes Gentry and her friend, Mac, back in time to Christmas 1995. There, she's able to spend time with her late country star dad, as well as discover romance with Mac. Starring Nikki DeLoach, Kris Polaha.

programme.title: A Very Merry Mix-Up
programme.desc: A woman goes to meet her fiancé's family at Christmas and winds up at the wrong house. Once the mistake is corrected, she realizes that her bond with the wrong family, and their eligible son, was stronger than she expected.

programme.title: Garage Sale Mysteries: Picture a Murder
programme.desc: Jenn acquires an antique camera from the estate of a deceased and seemingly wealthy photography enthusiast. When Jenn gets the photos in the camera printed, it leads her to believe that the man's death was anything but accidental.

programme.title: Flower Shop Mystery: Mum's the Word
programme.desc: Abby Knight is the proud owner of her hometown flower shop, but a SUV just rammed her vintage Corvette in a hit-and-run. She's determined to track down the driver, but the trail turns deadly.

programme.title: Flower Shop Mystery: Snipped in the Bud
programme.desc: When a bouquet from her shop is found at the murder scene of a professor and former courtroom adversary of Abby Knight, a former attorney-turned-small-town-florist, she finds herself as the main suspect. Stars Brooke Shields.

programme.title: Flower Shop Mystery: Dearly Depotted
programme.desc: Abby Knight, ex-lawyer and crime buff, and the owner of Bloomers Flower Shop, is having a week to be reckoned with. A bridesmaid at her drama queen cousin's wedding, Abby ends having to find out who murdered a wedding crasher.

programme.title: Fixer Upper Mysteries: Framed for Murder
programme.desc: Shannon Hammer, owner of Hammer Construction Company, is an expert in Victorian home restoration. Through her renovations she will find clues to uncover a house's secret past and in turn become an unlikely sleuth.

programme.title: Fixer Upper Mysteries: Concrete Evidence
programme.desc: When Mac first moved to Lighthouse Cove, he bought the historic lighthouse mansion that the town is named after. During renovation demolition, the bones of a teenage girl were discovered. Stars Jewel and Colin Ferguson.

programme.title: Fixer Upper Mysteries: Deadly Deed
programme.desc: Shannon Hughes has taken on a charity project renovating an old Victorian mansion. When a local banker is found murdered inside, Shannon must dust off the clues and cement the truth before her renovation becomes a demolition.

programme.title: A Beautiful Place to Die: A Martha's Vineyard Mystery
programme.desc: After being forced into retirement, former detective Jeff Jackson returns to a quiet life on Martha's Vineyard. Quiet, at least, until a body washes up and he's drawn back into crime solving. Stars Jesse Metcalfe, Sarah Lind.

programme.title: Riddled with Deceit: A Martha's Vineyard Mystery
programme.desc: Former detective Jeff Jackson teams up with Dr. Zee Madeiras to track down their friend's missing emerald brooch, a thief, and also... a murderer. Stars Jesse Metcalfe, Sarah Lind.

programme.title: Ships in the Night: A Martha's Vineyard Mystery
programme.desc: When an art gallery robbery leads to the death of the contemptible gallery manager, former Boston detective teams up with local doctor--and old flame-- to catch the killer. Stars Jesse Metcalfe and Sarah Lind.

programme.title: Poisoned in Paradise: A Martha's Vineyard Mystery
programme.desc: When a local waitress is found dead on the beach and a mysterious deposit appears in Zee's bank account, Martha's Vineyard proves to be all but the simple, scenic life Jeff Jackson was after. Stars Jesse Metcalfe and Sarah Lind.

programme.title: Mystery Island: Pilot
programme.desc: When a visit to a mystery-themed resort goes wrong, a local detective and a vacationing British criminal psychiatrist team up to solve a real murder. Starring Elizabeth Henstridge, Charlie Weber.

programme.title: The Cases of Mystery Lane: Pilot
programme.desc: Birdie and Alden Case find a way to keep the mystery in their marriage alive, literally, when the amateur sleuths are pulled into a murder investigation. Stars Aimee Garcia, Paul Campbell.

programme.title: The Cases of Mystery Lane: Death is Listening
programme.desc: As Birdie and Alden Case's relationship strengthens, they discover a mutual interest for True Crime. But when their favorite podcaster is found dead, it is up to The Cases to listen to the clues. Stars Aimee Garcia, Paul Campbell.

programme.title: Aurora Teagarden Mysteries: Til Death Do Us Part
programme.desc: Just days before Aurora's wedding, a body is discovered, and she fears her father may be a suspect. She and Nick race to solve the cold case before they walk down the aisle. Stars Candace Cameron Bure, Niall Matter, Marilu Henner.

programme.title: Aurora Teagarden Mysteries: Honeymoon, Honeymurder
programme.desc: While on a "pre-honeymoon" getaway, Aurora and Nick discover a body, and as they get closer to finding out what really happened, danger knocks on their doorstep. Stars Candace Cameron Bure, Niall Matter, Marilu Henner.

programme.title: Aurora Teagarden Mysteries: Haunted By Murder
programme.desc: A murder investigation is reignited in a house that is considered haunted by the Lawrenceton locals and where years ago Aurora and Sally, as teenagers, discovered a body. Stars Candace Cameron Bure, Niall Matter, Marilu Henner.

programme.title: Tipline Mysteries: Dial 1 for Murder
programme.desc: A cryptic call about a planned jewelry heist draws a Detroit Free Press tipline operator, Maddie Moore, into a dangerous homicide case alongside a newly promoted detective. Stars Holland Roden and Chris McNally.

programme.title: Nelly Knows Mysteries: A Fatal Engagement
programme.desc: When advice columnist NELLY finds her childhood friend DAHLIA's boyfriend dead, she joins DETECTIVE HOGAN to help find the killer. However, as suspicions creep in, Dahlia becomes a prime suspect. Stars Pascale Hutton, Kavan Smith.

programme.title: Nelly Knows Mysteries: All Manners of Murder
programme.desc: Advice columnist Nelly is invited to a lavish dinner at Grand Arlott manor after encouraging an eccentric widow to reconcile with her estranged family and brings Detective Michael as her date. Stars Pascale Hutton, Kavan Smith.

programme.title: Knock Knock You're Dead
programme.desc: Summer, 2001 and Southern Louisiana is held in the terrifying grip of a serial killer whose initial ‘hot zone’ is the Louisiana State University area of Baton Rouge. State of the art forensic science, particularly case-making DNA analysis, will turn the tables on this killer and finally put a face to the monster that haunts Southern Louisiana.
